*Full Introduction
【Game background based on m
bluejetty:00084135:ios.description:
The game restores the magnificence of the medieval maritime empires, with maps spanning across Western and Northern Europe as well as the Caribbean. A new map, Atlantis, will soon be released.
*Full Introduction
【Game background based on massive and in-depth historical research】
The periods of Renaissance and Enlightenment resulted in the Freedom of Thought that created a thirst for all things new in the European Continent of the Middle Ages, which propelled the process of civilization exploration. At the same time, the accumulation of wealth led to a prosperous commerce trade, while technological advances allowed Europeans to traverse further and faster into unknown territories. With this, the people who have never ventured beyond the European Continent ushered in an all-new Age of Sail.
To revive the full splendor of the Age of Exploration, we consulted large volumes of related historical materials and went to great lengths to ensure that all aspects of the game, from graphics to the choice of words, remain faithful to the norms of the era. The architectural styles and trade specialties of the various regions – Mediterranean, Asian and Latin American accurately reflect the respective histories and the inclusion of long-renowned sea captains and explorers is set to bring players an immersive gaming experience.
【Unique trading system in which players’ behavior influences the trading prices】
In the real world, commodity prices are mainly determined by cost as well as supply and demand. In most trading games, however, commodity trading prices are almost always constant, which is completely unrealistic. We strive to create a highly realistic trading system that brings realism to players.
In King of Oceans, the trading prices largely depend on players’ trading behaviors – centralizing the trading of certain goods may cause prices to fall drastically in the city. Powerful players may even dictate the price fluctuation of the commodities. The rapid and constant changes bring extreme excitement about the unknown to every deal. 
【Realistic and familiar trade specialties】
All cities in King of Oceans are chosen from famed ports in the North, Baltic and Mediterranean seas during the Age of Exploration. Every city has its own specialty produce bearing strong regional characteristics. The supply and demand of the goods determines the price difference, and players have to grasp the timing of these price differences to secure an invincible trading position.
【Be the ultimate victor in our cross-server battles!】
King of Oceans supports data exchange among multiple servers, thus enabling players across different servers to either form allies or opposing camps fighting on the same battlefield. The one who stands last shall be our overall champion and win the admiration of all other players!
*Contact Us*
Should you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave us a message on our official FB page: https://www.facebook.com/The-King-Of-Ocean-363419481184754

bluejetty:00045829:ios.description:
Sometime lets you easily track and complete recurring tasks in your daily life.
People have used it to:
- Know when to take medicine and remember the last time they did it
- Keep their plants alive by being gently reminded
- Be on top of paying their bills every month
- Check when and where they got their last haircut
- Replace their Brita water filter on time before the inevitable algae domination
- And more!
———
YOUR TASKS AT A GLANCE
- See all of your tasks with reminders for Today and in the Future.
- Organize your tasks into categories and quickly switch between them.
- Sort by Last Done to see tasks you haven't done in a while.
- Sort by Upcoming to see reminder times more clearly.
SET FLEXIBLE REMINDERS
- Set a reminder that occurs minutes/hours/days/weeks/months after your task is completed.
- Set a daily reminder that occurs at the times you specify.
- Set a weekly, monthly or yearly reminder at the days and times you specify.
- Set a one-off reminder at a date and time you specify.
- Choose a custom notification sound.
- (Pro) Get notified after your task is past deadline with overdue reminders.
VISUALIZE YOUR HABITS
- Get a better sense of how often you complete a task with informative charts.
- See your average, shortest and longest time interval between completions.
- Easily add, edit and remove completions from history.
OTHER FEATURES
- (Pro) Add notes when you complete a task to remember additional context.
- iCloud sync: Keep your data private and in sync across your devices.
- Notification and Spotlight search actions: Quickly complete a task or set a one-off reminder without opening the app first.
- Home screen widgets
 - Task: See the next reminder date or the last completion for a task.
 - Today: See upcoming reminders for all tasks or tasks in a category.
- Support for Siri and Shortcuts with actions like:
 - Get tasks for today
 - Complete a task
 - Get last completion date for a task
 - Get the next reminder date for a task
 - Remind me later for a task
- Export your task completions as CSV.
Have feedback, suggestions or questions?
Contact us at support@irisation.com

bluejetty:00039246:ios.name: MediCode- ACLS, PALS, BLS, CPR
bluejetty:00039246:ios.summary: Tired of carrying a set of expandable CPR cards all the time for algorithms? Flipping through the cards to find the right one wastes valuable time in emergency health care situations such as cardiac arrest and pediatric urgent care. MediCod
bluejetty:00039246:ios.description:
Tired of carrying a set of expandable CPR cards all the time for algorithms? Flipping through the cards to find the right one wastes valuable time in emergency health care situations such as cardiac arrest and pediatric urgent care. MediCode gives you easy access to all of the International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation (ILCOR) algorithms from the palm of your hand and includes multiple-choice practice tests for you to test your skills.
This Algorithms, Practice Tests, Megacodes, and ebooks app makes it easy for physicians, paramedics, and nurses to care and save lives. Download this health care professional’s app for free.
As health care professionals - critical care physicians, nurses, medical students, paramedics, and Emergency Medical Technicians (EMT), you save lives every day. In times of emergency, others turn to you and trust that you will take the right steps to save them or their loved ones. But no emergency situation is the same. Having a set of tools in your pocket can make all the difference. The MediCode app is a simple, easy-to-use resource for all of your ACLS (including core ECG rhythms), BLS, PALS and NR skills needs, including CPR and first aid. As our gift to you, we are making this health care app, along with downloadable ebooks, available to you for free!
At Save a Life by Advanced Medical Certification (AMC), the premier provider for online certification and recertification courses, we believe that improvements can be made through providing exceptional education and resources. Save a Life by Advanced Medical Certification has compiled a list of the vital Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), Neonatal Resuscitation (NR) and CPR and first aid algorithms, all of which can be viewed and navigated with the touch of your finger.
Test your ACLS, BLS, CPR, PALS, first aid and ECG knowledge and skills with our free practice tests. Each skills test consists of 10 multiple-choice questions that are derived from our provider ebooks and adhere to the latest guidelines.
Download MediCode and our lifesaving ebooks now and start saving lives! Review our newest ECG rhythms and interpretations resource in our ACLS ebook. Also, check out our CertAlert+ app to conveniently access all your licenses and certifications in one place anytime, anywhere.
The individual algorithms included in MediCode are:
• BLS
- Adult BLS Algorithm
- Pediatric BLS Algorithm
• ACLS
- Cardiac Arrest Algorithm
- Details for Cardiac Arrest
- Immediate Post Cardiac-Arrest Care Algorithm
- Bradycardia with Pulse Algorithm
- Tachycardia with Pulse Algorithm
• PALS
- Pediatric Cardiac Arrest Algorithm
- Details for Pediatric Cardiac Arrest
- Immediate Post for Cardiac Arrest
- Pediatric Bradycardia with Pulse/Poor Perfusion Algorithm
- Pediatric Tachycardia Algorithm
• NR
- Neonatal Resuscitation Algorithm
• CPR and First Aid
- Adult BLS Algorithm
- Simple Adult BLS Algorithm
MediCode is a well-organized, polished, and easy-to-use health care professional’s app that walks you through the many algorithms and practice tests - ACLS, BLS, PALS, NR, and CPR and First Aid. MediCode also provides ebooks, including our newest ECG rhythms and interpretations section of our ACLS handbook, to enhance your skills in emergencies.

The MM & PB app gives you the latest jackpot information and drawing results with push notifications for Mega Millions and Powerball lottery games.  It has prize payouts and calculates prize winnings for your purchased tickets.

FEATURES 
* Get the latest jackpot information with draw date and current winning numbers 
* Get notifications on drawing results and when jackpot reaches a level
* Get access to drawing history database
* Get payout/prize information
* Save your favorite numbers/multi-draw/subscription tickets and calculate winnings
* Use quick pick/number generator to pick one or all your numbers

This app does not sell Mega Millions and Powerball lottery tickets. To play, you will have to purchase tickets from a state lottery in: Arizona (AZ), Arkansas (AR), California (CA), Colorado (CO), Connecticut (CT), Delaware (DE), District of Columbia (DC), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Idaho (ID), Illinois (IL), Indiana (IN), Iowa (IA), Kansas (KS), Kentucky (KY), Louisiana (LA), Maine (ME), Maryland (MD), Massachusetts (MA), Michigan (MI), Minnesota (MN), Mississippi (MS), Missouri (MO), Montana (MT), Nebraska (NE), New Hampshire (NH), New Jersey (NJ), New Mexico (NM), New York (NY), North Carolina (NC), North Dakota (ND), Ohio (OH), Oklahoma (OK), Oregon (OR), Pennsylvania (PA), Rhode Island (RI), South Carolina (SC), South Dakota (SD), Tennessee (TN), Texas (TX), US Virgin Islands (VI), Vermont (VT), Virginia (VA), Washington (WA), West Virginia (WV), Wisconsin (WI) and Wyoming (WY).  Puerto Rico (PR) has Powerball but not Mega Millions.

This is an ad-supported app.  If you need state lottery results, please download our free Lotto Results app.

Please send questions/comments/requests to support@mylottos.com or visit www.mmpb.app.

bluejetty:00061453:ios.description:
Learn how lenders evaluate your business. Nav combines your business and personal credit, cash flow, and other key factors into a clear picture of your potential funding eligibility, with personalized guidance to help you improve.
Get basic tools for free, or unlock more powerful support with Nav Prime. Features vary by plan.
Know where you stand
• Track your business credit with Experian, Dun & Bradstreet, Equifax, and FICO SBSS
• Track your personal credit with Experian and TransUnion
• See the factors that impact your credit and take control with real-time alerts
• Avoid negative balance surprises with cash flow forecasting 
• Sort transactions automatically for simpler bookkeeping
• Export detailed financial statements to help with tax prep 
Get clear next steps
• Check your funding readiness assessment to learn what matters most to work toward approval for loans, credit cards, or trade credit — before you apply
• Prioritize the right next steps for your business with intelligent recommendations powered by your credit, cash flow, and business data
• Unlock 1-on-1 support with a dedicated business credit coach with the Nav Prime Expand plan
Move with confidence
• Unlock a business credit-building tradeline that reports to all major business bureaus 
• Get matched with net-30+, lending, and credit card picks that update automatically as your profile changes, across our network of 160+ options
• Use our cohort analysis to track your eligibility compared to other businesses like yours that were approved.
Nav has given 2.7 million business owners the insights they need to build and grow.
DISCLAIMERS
**Nav Technologies, Inc. is a financial technology company, not a bank**
**Credit building**
Credit building results vary. Scores are calculated based on multiple factors, and some users may not see improved scores.
**Credit-building tradeline**
Select Nav Prime plans include one business tradeline. The ability to apply for additional tradelines is limited to customers on eligible plans and is subject to availability and approval.
**Funding Readiness assessment**
Funding Readiness assessments are based on your business information, third-party data, and aggregated marketplace approval patterns. They are for informational purposes only, do not reflect any individual lender's criteria, and are not a credit decision, pre-approval, or guarantee of funding, rates, or terms.
**Privacy**
Your privacy is important to us, and we do not allow third parties to collect personally identifiable information without your permission. Read more at https://www.nav.com/privacy/ 
**Data security**
We take your online security seriously, which is why we use Plaid to connect your bank and other accounts. Plaid has bank-level encryption.
**Your curated funding options**
Credit card and funding options shown in your Nav account are from our network of partner providers. Offers range from credit cards to lines of credit, merchant cash advances, and loans. We match offers based on information you provide in your business profile, including your time in business, cash flow, and annual revenue.

Get ready for a Lewis Carroll inspired hidden object game that will transport you to a mystical Victorian-era London, fraught with
bluejetty:00019238:ios.description:
Mind Fitness: Your daily mind flex with the best puzzle games!
Solve the mystery of Alice’s disappearance!
Get ready for a Lewis Carroll inspired hidden object game that will transport you to a mystical Victorian-era London, fraught with intrigue, crime, and danger. Just like Alice on her journey to Wonderland, you’ll have to solve challenging puzzles and face unexplained mysteries. Experience the game's unique story by tackling countless quests on your mission to foil the Queen of Hearts' evil schemes. Download Alice in the Mirrors of Albion and set off on an adventure in this truly extraordinary and magical world right now!
**KEY FEATURES** 
• FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS
Track down all sorts of items in several exciting game modes and explore a wide range of locations, from the dangerous outskirts of Albion to elegant Victorian-era studies and quaint confectioneries.
• MEET INTRIGUING CHARACTERS
Immerse yourself in the magical world beyond the mirror, full of heroes you’ve known since childhood as well as unique new characters, all of whom have something to hide.
• UNRAVEL PLOTS AND FIGHT CRIME
Engage in exciting battles with the criminals of Albion and prove that you can bring order to the city and learn all its secrets.
• IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE MYSTERIOUS DETECTIVE STORY
Go on a journey through foggy Albion, a city full of thieves, puzzles, and wonder. Discover things that no one else has seen!
• EXPLORE NEW PLACES EVERY DAY
Earn experience points to gain access to incredible new places and buildings! If you’re hungry for more, you can always purchase keys to new locations and other items within the game with real money to speed up the process.
• APPLE WATCH COMPANION APP. Unlock chests and find valuable bonuses every few hours. If you want more, just allow access to your health data and earn rewards for your steps! Keep track of all events, energy amounts, and the duration of amulets. Now, you won’t miss a thing!
• THIS GAME WORKS IN OFFLINE MODE WITHOUT AN INTERNET CONNECTION — enjoy it on a plane, on the subway, or on the road!

bluejetty:00047713:ios.description:
Panoramic Martial Arts Kingdom
Powered by the second generation Flexi Engine, Sword of Shadows takes players on an authentic journey through an ancient martial arts kingdom, as they become legendary warriors. We've paid incredible attention to detail to ensure that Sword of Shadows raises the bar in terms of what 3D mobile games can accomplish visually.
Revolutionary Flying Skills & Sky Battles
In Sword of Shadows, players can literally take flight, allowing them to experience a martial arts battle like never before. The Eight Fighting Flying Skill allows players to soar above their PvP opponents. Players can also learn the Ultra Flying Skills to fly across Sword of Shadows' expansive map.
Fast-Paced and Dynamic Combat
Sword of Shadows' fast-paced and dynamic combat mechanism allows players to adjust the combat mode based on the circumstances of the fight. Players will master a range of martial arts abilities and battle tactics, including the ability to block feints and break through defenses to defeat opponents. bluejetty:00080517:ios.description:
Welcome to Match Out! Dive into this vibrant 3D world where you can explore adorable animals, delicious foods, and unexpected surprises. Each level presents unique and enchanting 3D items that you need to find and match within a limited time. Here, you'll not only enhance your memory and exercise your brain, but you'll also elevate your matching skills to new heights!
Match Out is perfect for players who love a relaxing yet challenging puzzle game. Whether you’re at home or on the go, Match Out is the ideal companion for a pleasant holiday and doubles as your brain trainer.
How to play:
Find three identical 3D objects, match them, and collect.
Continue matching until you clear all the 3D objects from the screen.
Complete each level’s objectives to become a master of 3D matching games.
Use boosters to help clear obstacles and navigate through tough levels.
Features:
A relaxing and fun triple-matching game, suitable for all ages.
Beautifully designed 3D items that create a satisfying visual experience with every level.
Difficulty increases with each level, testing your matching skills and training your brain.
Unlock levels with unique themes: fruits, toys, cakes... and many more surprises to discover.
If you're a fan of matching games, Match Out is the perfect choice for you. Join the matching party and become a master of 3D matching games!

• Breathing disorders
• Cardiovascular disorders
• Critical care disease
• Diffuse parenchymal lung disease 
• Infectious disease
• Neoplasia 
• Normal sleep and variants 
• Neurologic disorders 
• Obstructive lung disease
• Obstructive sleep apnea
• Renal, endocrine, and metabolic disorders
• Pulmonary disease

WritBot helps you create high-quality content in seconds. Whether you're writing emails, essays, blog posts, social media captions, marketing copy, or professional documents, WritBot gives you the tools to write faster and with confidence.
Designed for students, professionals, creators, and businesses, WritBot combines powerful AI with an intuitive experience to help you generate, improve, and organize your writing.
Features
-Generate blogs, articles, essays, stories, and creative content
-Write professional emails with engaging subject lines
-Create marketing copy, ads, product descriptions, and social media posts
-Rewrite, expand, shorten, or improve existing text
-Summarize long documents into clear, concise content
-Brainstorm ideas and overcome writer's block
-Chat with AI to ask questions, generate ideas, or get writing assistance
-Choose from over 70 writing templates for different use cases
-Support for more than 180 languages
-Save and revisit your writing history anytime
-Clean, fast, and easy-to-use interface
-Generate original, high-quality content for work, study, and everyday writing
AI chat assistant
Need more than content generation? Use the built-in AI chat assistant to ask questions, refine your writing, brainstorm ideas, or get instant help with almost any writing task.
Built for every writer
Whether you're creating business documents, academic assignments, marketing campaigns, or everyday messages, WritBot helps you produce polished content in less time.
WritBot Premium
Unlock unlimited access to all premium features with a monthly or yearly subscription.
Premium includes:
-Unlimited AI generations
-Full access to every writing template
-Advanced AI writing tools
-Unlimited AI chat
-Premium updates and future features
A free 3-day trial is available for eligible yearly subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID after purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/writbotprivacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/writbottermsandconditions

bluejetty:00087231:ios.description:
Fontix is the best fonts & keyboards app for iPhone to send fancy texts and create captions, posts, stories on social platforms. Enhance the aesthetics of your texts with the coolest collection of fonts and symbols.
Change the way you write on your iPhone with different types of custom colorful keyboard themes. Transform simple boring words into stylish custom texts with special characters and symbols.
Key Features of Fonts & Keyboard:
- Lots of stylish and cute fonts to choose from
- Use aesthetic fonts everywhere, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, WhatsApp, Messenger, Snapchat, etc.
- Countless fancy symbols and letters
- Elegant collection of keyboard themes
Unique Fonts Types
Fonts & Keyboard app for iPhone lets you incorporate unique fonts styles anywhere you want. Post incredible stories on social platforms using fancy alphabets or letters that fit your mood. Fontix makes it exceptionally easy to directly type in any font into other apps.
Elegant and Cute Keyboard Symbols
Spoil yourself with a diverse range of cool letter symbols. While choosing the writing style, don't worry about how to copy and paste lettering fonts, symbols, or texts. Do it instantly with this fancy keyboard.
iPhone Keyboard Themes
Give your typing keyboards a personalized flair using different types of keyboard patterns. Change the outlook of your iPhone keyboard backgrounds and start typing in style.
How to change font on iPhone using the Fonts & Keyboard app?
Fontix integrates a seamless method of using cool fonts to elevate the keyboard typing experience. Easily change fonts on iPhone by following the steps given below.
- Start the app
- Go to Settings and tap on "Fonts"
- Choose your font types and press "Done"
- Alternatively, hold the "Globe" icon on the keyboard
- Select "Fontix" to change iPhone text fonts
How to change keyboard color on iPhone with Fontix?
Redesign and change iPhone keyboard color in any way you want by using themes. Go through the following steps in your Fontix app to change the color successfully.
- Tap on "Add Keyboard" after starting the app
- Press on "Keyboard" and enable "Fontix"
- Now, change the keyboard themes from the app

bluejetty:00039792:ios.description:
L'application du Nouvelliste, le journal quotidien valaisan, vous informe sur l’actualité régionale, suisse et internationale:
• suivez l’info en direct
• suivez les grands évènements régionaux, suisses et internationaux : sportifs, politiques, culturels
• personnalisez les thématiques qui vous intéressent le plus dans la section "Ma une"
• recevez les alertes d’actualité en temps réel
Avec nos contenus destinés aux abonnés, profitez :
• d’une sélection des contenus indispensables pour comprendre l'actualité régionale
• du décryptage des préoccupations et débats qui vous concernent directement
• de l’accès personnel et illimité à tous les contenus payants
• du Journal Digital et ses suppléments thématiques :
 o partout et vingt-quatre heures sur vingt-quatre sur tous les écrans
 o accès aux 30 dernières éditions, au minimum
 o possibilité de consulter Le Nouvelliste en mode « hors ligne », après l’avoir téléchargé
En plus de l’actualité et l’information, Le Nouvelliste vous propose les services suivants : 
• la liste des décès contenant nom, prénom, localité et année de naissance
• nos concours
• nos articles enrichis de galeries d’images et/ou de vidéos
• la fonction « Témoin-lecteur » vous permettant de transmettre à la rédaction une photo ou une vidéo d’un évènement, d'un fait divers, etc...
Découvrez LE NOUVELLISTE NUMÉRIQUE:
Abonnez-vous directement depuis l'application: vous bénéficiez alors d’un accès libre aux articles du Nouvelliste et ses magazines dans l’application.
• Abonnement mensuel CHF 29.- reconductible et sans engagement de durée,
• L’abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés en vous rendant dans votre compte App Store après l’achat.
• Le paiement sera débité du compte iTunes à la confirmation de l'achat
• L'abonnement est automatiquement renouvelé, sauf si le renouvellement automatique est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours.
• Le compte sera facturé pour le renouvellement dans les 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours, et le coût du renouvellement sera déterminé
• Les abonnements peuvent être gérés par l'utilisateur et le renouvellement automatique peut être désactivé en accédant aux paramètres du compte de l'utilisateur après l'achat.
• Toute portion inutilisée d'une période d'essai gratuite, si elle est offerte, sera perdue lorsque l'utilisateur achète un abonnement à cette publication, le cas échéant
Achetez le quotidien ou les magazines à l’unité :
• Le quotidien disponible en achat à l’unité à CHF 3.-
Plus d’infos à cette adresse: https://www.lenouvelliste.ch/pages/conditions-generales-sur-le-nouvelliste-506132

bluejetty:00031327:ios.description:

Send the Perfect Gift in Seconds

Personalize with heartfelt e-greeting cards for every occasion
Add a custom message, stickers, collages, or even voice notes
All-in-One Gifting & Events

Easily track RSVPs and let guests know exactly what gifts you want

Learn BaZi quickly with an app that does all calculations for you.
BaZi Hero uses an advanced algorithm to generate accurate charts, making it easy for beginners and useful for professionals.
Create charts, explore your Day Master, check your Luck Pillars, and understand the Five Elements in a clear and intuitive way.
You can also analyze friends and family and build your own database inside the app.
Main Features
• Dynamic daily chart
Shows the current day and hour updates in real time.
• BaZi Chart Generator
Create charts and organize them in your personal database.
• Luck Pillars
Landscape view, detailed breakdown, and future cycle insights.
• Day Master Strength
Clear evaluation with extended analysis.
• Solar Time Conversion
Automatic local-to-solar time adjustment.
• Five Element Strength
Instant overview of elemental balance.
• Profiles (Gods) & Supertalents
Discover character profiles and advanced Supertalent indicators.
• Five Components
Detailed interpretation of each component in the chart.
• Talent Bridge & Dynamic Talent Bridge
Understand how your talents interact and develop over time.
• Qi Analysis
Warm vs. Cold Qi breakdown and useful element suggestions (Qi Boost).
• Import & Export Database
Easily manage your saved charts.
• Blog Access
Case studies, BaZi education, and news directly inside the app.
• Widgets
Display the daily BaZi Chart on your home screen.
BaZi Hero helps you learn the system step by step and gives you all the tools you need to analyze charts confidently.

Monthly subscription - 11.99 € per month

If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
All BaZi Hero subscriptions are renewed automatically to ensure uninterrupted service, using the credit card on file.
Annual subscriptions are billed in one payment at the time of purchase and automatically renew at the end of the initial term, at the rate secured at the time of purchase.
Please note that if you purchase a subscription through the Apple iTunes Store or our iPhone application, the sale is final, and we will not provide a refund. Your purchase will be subject to Apple’s applicable payment policy, which may not provide for refunds.

Turn Your Pronunciation Practice into a Fun Adventure! 
Dive into an exciting game where your pronunciation is the key to success! Challenge yourself with pronunciation tasks, unlock doors, and guide your character through thrilling obstacles. Test your vocabulary skills across exciting categories and levels!
Why You’ll Love This App
Interactive Gameplay: Control your character by speaking correctly to clear obstacles.
Diverse Levels: Choose from Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert levels to match your skills.
Exciting Themes: Explore categories like Daily Words, Travel, and Fun Tongue Twisters.
Time-Based Challenges: Stay on your toes with quick rounds that test your reflexes and skills.
Track Your Progress: Reduce mistakes, and reach new milestones.
Go Viral: Turn your rankings into social media trends—be the next big content creator!
Connect Globally: Join a global ranking community and explore the preferences of people around the world.
How to Play
Pick Your Challenge: Choose a category and difficulty level—Beginner, Intermediate, or Expert.
Stay Sharp: Answer quickly to overcome obstacles and avoid penalties.
Compete and Share: Show off your video and challenge friends to beat your pronunciation.
Game Features
Challenge Modes: Play in Easy, Medium, or Hard mode with customizable difficulty.
Dynamic Obstacles: Overcome unique challenges with precise pronunciation.
Regular Updates: Enjoy fresh content and new levels added regularly.
Social Sharing: Share your scores and achievements with friends to keep the competition alive!
Who Is It For?
Perfect for learners, travelers, and anyone who loves a mix of fun and learning. Whether you’re practicing pronunciation or just enjoying a unique voice-controlled game, this app has something for everyone!
Start Your Pronunciation Adventure Today!
Download now and take the first step toward improving your skills while having endless fun!

bluejetty:00022594:ios.summary:
Unlock the Ultimate Solitaire Experience with 700 Unique Games in One Massive Collection!
Dive into the most comprehensive solitaire suite ever built for iPhone and iPad. Whether you are a casual player or a seasoned pro, 700 Solitaire Gam
bluejetty:00022594:ios.description:
Unlock the Ultimate Solitaire Experience with 700 Unique Games in One Massive Collection!
Dive into the most comprehensive solitaire suite ever built for iPhone and iPad. Whether you are a casual player or a seasoned pro, 700 Solitaire Games Pro offers an unparalleled variety of card games, ranging from world-famous classics to rare, challenging gems.
EXPLORE A VAST LIBRARY
Our intuitive interface makes finding your next favorite game effortless. Navigate through four dedicated tabs:
- Games: Browse the full catalog in a sleek Table or Icon view. Sort games by name or popularity and use the lightning-fast search bar to find exactly what you’re looking for.
- Favorites: Keep your most-loved games just a tap away.
- Recents: A specialized hall of fame featuring every game you’ve successfully conquered.
- Filter: Narrow down the 700 options by Skill Level, Odds of Winning, Completion Time, Deck Amount, or Category (Free Cell, Klondike, Spider, Pyramid, Canfield, Forty Thieves, Yukon, and Pairing).
DETAILED GAME INSIGHTS
Before you deal the first card, get the full breakdown for every game:
- Win Metrics: See the Skill Level (from All Skill to All Luck) and Odds of Winning.
- Game Specs: Check the deck count (1–4 decks) and estimated completion time.
- Community Stats: View global ratings (1–5 stars) and popularity bars.
- Custom Seeds: Enter a unique seed number to replay specific card distributions or challenge friends.
- Layout Editor: Use the Edit button to customize the position of card piles to suit your visual preference without changing the core rules.
POWERFUL GAMEPLAY FEATURES
Experience smooth, responsive gameplay with professional tools at your fingertips:
- Smart Hints: Highlight playable cards in yellow to keep the game moving.
- Unlimited Undo: Made a mistake? Step back as many times as you need.
- Seed Control: Play the same deal again or try a completely new one.
- Interactive Rules: Detailed text instructions are available for every single one of the 700 games.
PERSONALIZE YOUR TABLE
Make the game truly yours with deep customization options in the Preferences menu:
- Visuals: Choose from various card faces, card backs, and beautiful backgrounds (or use your own photos!).
- Controls: Enable Single Touch Action, Auto-Jump to Foundations, or a Left-Handed Layout.
- Animations: Fine-tune movement speed (Slow/Normal/Fast) and toggle start/win effects.
- Visual Aids: Toggle "Mark Selected Cards," "Mark Target Piles," or "Mark Indicated Piles" for maximum precision.
TWO MORE WAYS TO PLAY
- Daily Challenge: three games for every day of the calendar — short, medium and long. Missed days stay open.
- Journeys: more than forty sets of games, played one after another, each with its own progress and leaderboard.
COMPETE AND TRACK PROGRESS
- Advanced Statistics: Monitor your wins, losses, win percentages, and best times for both the entire collection and each individual game.
- Global Leaderboards: Submit your scores with your name and country to see how you stack up against players worldwide. Filter top scores by Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, or All-Time Top 30.
- Puzzles and Badges: win the games on a grid to uncover a picture piece by piece, while badges and levels reward your progress.
- One Purchase, Everything Included: no ads and no subscriptions. Your progress from earlier versions carries over and is backed up to iCloud.
Download 700 Solitaire Games Pro today and carry the world's largest card game library in your pocket!
700 Solitaire Games Pro is for you if like:
- single / solo player games like sudoku, mahjong, puzzles
- multiplayer, board and family games like chess, dominoes, backgammon, reversi, poker, blackjack, checkers (draughts, dame), dice games
Privacy Policy:
https://700solitairegames.com/pro/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use:
https://700solitairegames.com/pro/terms-of-use/

Danger lurks everywhere. Survive against zombies using rifles, grenades, shotguns, and anything in your arsenal to secure safe havens and save survivors. bluejetty:00070261:ios.description:

- Create your own original LINE stickers from photos and videos taken with your camera.

bluejetty:00016518:ios:0.description:
Battle as legendary Warcraft heroes in Hearthstone®, Blizzard Entertainment's award-winning free-to-play* strategy card game. Build powerful decks, collect iconic cards, discover game-changing combos, and outsmart opponents in epic card battles!
ONE GAME. COUNTLESS WAYS TO PLAY. 
Whether you're new to collectible card games (CCG) or a seasoned strategist, Hearthstone offers an experience for every kind of player. Challenge friends, test your skills against opponents from around the world, or enjoy solo adventures at your own pace. Every match is packed with opportunities to learn, experiment, and sharpen your skills. 
Develop strategies that fit your playstyle, craft Legendary cards, and discover new possibilities as your collection grows. Easy to learn and rewarding to master, Hearthstone offers fresh challenges with every game. 
Play online across mobile and PC with your Hearthstone collection and progress synced between devices. Whether you have a few minutes for a quick match or you're ready to climb the competitive ladder, your next match is always within reach. 
Collect. Build. Play.
CLIMB TO LEGEND 
• Battle players from around the world in strategic online PvP duels. 
• Build winning decks, evolve your strategy, and climb all the way to Legend. 
• Earn seasonal rewards and prove your mastery every month. 
HONE YOUR CRAFT
• Take on solo adventures, complete quests, and discover new mechanics at your own pace. 
• Draft a unique deck in Arena from a changing selection of cards, then test your strategy against other players. 
• Returning player? Wild mode lets you play with all your cards! 
OUTSMART RIVALS 
• Recruit powerful minions, build your warband, and compete against seven other players in Hearthstone's signature Battlegrounds auto-battler mode.
• Adapt every turn, discover powerful synergies, and be the last player standing. 
• No two matches play the same. 
EMBRACE THE CHAOS 
• Jump into Tavern Brawl, where unique rules, unexpected twists, and special rewards keep every Brawl fresh.
CHOOSE YOUR HERO 
• Battle as legendary Warcraft heroes across 11 distinct classes. 
• Each class features its own Hero Power, signature mechanics, and unique strategies. 
• Whether you prefer aggressive attacks, careful planning, or clever combos, there's a class for you. 
Complete quests, earn rewards, and discover new cards with every expansion. Regular balance updates, seasonal events, major expansions, and limited-time experiences keep Hearthstone fresh for newcomers and veterans alike. 
Experience the magic, mischief, and mayhem in this epic fantasy CCG. Battle friends, challenge online opponents, and join millions of players around the hearth. Play Hearthstone today! 
*In-game purchases are optional. 
©/TM/® 2026 Blizzard Entertainment, Inc

Challenge friends, test your skills against opponents from around the world, or enjoy solo adventures at your own pace. Every match is packed with opportunities to learn, experiment, and sharpen your skills. 

Develop strategies that fit your playstyle, craft Legendary cards, and discover new possibilities as your collection grows. Easy to learn and rewarding to master, Hearthstone offers fresh challenges with every game. 

Play online across mobile and PC with your Hearthstone collection and progress synced between devices. Whether you have a few minutes for a quick match or you're ready to climb the competitive ladder, your next match is always within reach. 

Collect. Build. Play.

CLIMB TO LEGEND 
• Battle players from around the world in strategic online PvP duels. 
• Build winning decks, evolve your strategy, and climb all the way to Legend. 
• Earn seasonal rewards and prove your mastery every month. 

HONE YOUR CRAFT
• Take on solo adventures, complete quests, and discover new mechanics at your own pace. 
• Draft a unique deck in Arena from a changing selection of cards, then test your strategy against other players. 
• Returning player? Wild mode lets you play with all your cards! 

OUTSMART RIVALS 
• Recruit powerful minions, build your warband, and compete against seven other players in Hearthstone's signature Battlegrounds auto-battler mode.
• Adapt every turn, discover powerful synergies, and be the last player standing. 
• No two matches play the same. 

EMBRACE THE CHAOS 
• Jump into Tavern Brawl, where unique rules, unexpected twists, and special rewards keep every Brawl fresh.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO 
• Battle as legendary Warcraft heroes across 11 distinct classes.  
• Each class features its own Hero Power, signature mechanics, and unique strategies. 
• Whether you prefer aggressive attacks, careful planning, or clever combos, there's a class for you. 

Complete quests, earn rewards, and discover new cards with every expansion. Regular balance updates, seasonal events, major expansions, and limited-time experiences keep Hearthstone fresh for newcomers and veterans alike. 

Experience the magic, mischief, and mayhem in this epic fantasy CCG. Battle friends, challenge online opponents, and join millions of players around the hearth. Play Hearthstone today!

bluejetty:00026155:ios.name: Duck Hunting 3D: FPS Shooting
bluejetty:00026155:ios.summary: Ready for a realistic hunting adventure in Duck Hunting 3D. Test your skills in immersive environments as you aim, shoot, and complete exciting hunting missions. Designed for fans of outdoor challenges and precision shooting, this game brin
bluejetty:00026155:ios.description:
Ready for a realistic hunting adventure in Duck Hunting 3D. Test your skills in immersive environments as you aim, shoot, and complete exciting hunting missions. Designed for fans of outdoor challenges and precision shooting, this game brings the thrill of the hunt to your device.
Features
Engaging Missions:
Track and hunt ducks across multiple levels with increasing difficulty.
Multiple Game Modes:
Practice your aim in training mode or take on real-time hunting challenges.
Wide Range of Weapons:
Use different rifles and shotguns, each with unique aiming mechanics.
Natural Environments:
Hunt in lakes, forests, and wetlands with dynamic lighting and weather.
Simple Controls:
Smooth and responsive FPS controls for all skill levels.
Modes:
There are various modes along with the Rare Card Challenge.
1- Bottle Shooting
In Bottle Shooting mode, you can shoot the bottles to set your aim. It is the practice mode to make you aiming master and the best shooter so that you can easily shoot ducks without missing any shot. Shoot down bottle caps in training to boost up your hunting expertise.
2- Hunting Campaign
In the Hunting Campaign Mode, you can shoot many ducks who are flying high in the sky. In this mode, you can also drive the car to go to the bank of the river for hunting. Your shepherd dog will help you out in collecting the hunted ducks.
3- Hunting with Friends
Hunting with Friends mode also consists of duck hunting in a bit challenging environment. You have to become a perfect FPS Shooter to pass this mode.
4- Sniper Hunting
In Sniper hunting mode, You have to be a perfect Sniper Shooter to hunt the animals. Different animals including deers, bears, dinos & other wild animals are there to hunt. Only use Sniper guns to kill the wild animals in the safari otherwise they are not going to kill and attack you.
5- Heli Hunt
Hunt animals in a different way from the helicopter to sharpen your aim. Be cautious in the jungle from different animals and prove your gun shooting skills in deer hunting simulator.
6- Jeep hunt
Hunt birds from the running jeep to showcase your bird hunting skills as shooting ducks like that is a bit different and needs advanced gun shooting skills.
Let's aim to become a master bird hunter. Try now and start your duck hunting journey today to become a pro Shooter!

Why is this photo hunt experience the best? Take a sneak peek at some awesome features of our Find The Difference game!

- Get coins by playing levels and spend them to unlock unique levels, etc
- Timer: find all differences in 60 sec
- Helpful hints to spot every single difference in levels
- Diverse themes of crisp pictures & photo categories
- Amazing music for you to enjoy the game even more
- Daily challenges for you to find differences and collect unique trophies
- Special levels to succeed - find 10 differences, spot more fun
- Zoom option helps to spot even tiniest puzzle differences

Console Tycoon is an exciting simulator where you can build your own gaming console empire!
Your journey begins in 1980, when the video game industry is just starting to take off. Design and launch home consoles, portable devices, gamepads
bluejetty:00088418:ios.description:
Console Tycoon is an exciting simulator where you can build your own gaming console empire!
Your journey begins in 1980, when the video game industry is just starting to take off. Design and launch home consoles, portable devices, gamepads, and VR headsets, creating them from the design phase to technical specifications in a unique editor with over 10,000 features!
Game Features:
Console Creation: Develop your unique gaming devices. From the exterior design to choosing technical specifications—you control every aspect. Get feedback from customers and aim for high ratings to boost your console sales!
Historical Mode: Dive into the realistic evolution of the gaming industry. All console features and capabilities match their time—online gaming will only appear when the internet becomes a daily reality for gamers.
Research and Development: Explore new technologies and features to stay ahead of the competition. Complete work contracts and sign exclusive deals with legendary game developers.
Marketing and Promotion: Promote your consoles, create advertising campaigns, and gain recognition from players worldwide.
Office Management: Start with a small office and grow! Upgrade your workspace, hire, and train employees to boost your team’s productivity and creativity.
Own Online Store: Create your game store and earn additional income by selling content.
And Much More: Expand your company, make strategic decisions, and build the most powerful gaming empire in the world!
Show everyone that you have what it takes to become a leader in the gaming industry with Console Tycoon! Grow your business, explore new technologies, and create legendary consoles that will change the gaming world!

Spending lots of hours reading God's word gives us hope for the now and also for the future.
KJV Study Bible app or King James Study Bible app makes a great resource for Christians/believers who desire to learn and study the Word of God in a deeper and in a profound way whether you are a beginner or a professional. This study Bible app will help you learn and gain new insights and perspectives about deeper things of God as this app contains extensive features that would really be helpful in your study of God’s Word such as:

• Daily Devotionals which contains specific spiritual readings and topics that would add up to your knowledge.
• Prayers which contains different kinds of prayers to guide you and assist you in your requests and petitions before the Lord.
• Bible Quizzes for making your study of God’s Word extra fun and enjoyable.
• There is also audio Bible in pure King James language that is good for people who are mostly on the road and would like to listen to the Bible whiles still paying attention to the road. • For those who are physically challenged we have a Bible section for Deaf people. Sign language is being used which means everyone can now study God's word no matter the situation they are in.
KJV (King James) Study Bible app is especially beneficial to women and men, Sunday school teachers, theologians, Bible believers, Pastors who would like to begin their study of God’s Word but don’t know how to start or where to start, and to guide them of their understanding of God’s Word.

King James Study Bible or Bible study app is one of the best to have in your cellphone or gadgets as you desire to grow more in your relationship with the Holy Spirit.
Download this Study Bible app now and take your study of God’s Word to the next level!

bluejetty:00083749:ios.description:
Welcome to MyActiveHealth!
We're thrilled to have you here. Here’s what you can look forward to:
MyHealth100 - Wondering how your health measures up? Check out MyHealth100. It’s a clear score on a scale of 0 to 100. You can see where your health stands today and discover actionable ways to improve it.
Pathways - Not sure how to begin your journey to better health? Explore personalized digital pathways that guide you toward your goals, like better sleep, staying active, or improving your nutrition. These pathways are tailored to you, based on your health info, including your health assessment. Daily check-ins help you build and sustain healthy habits with support from AI-powered recommendations.
Coaching - Take advantage of personal and group coaching to address chronic conditions, lifestyle risks, and tobacco cessation. Whether you need support managing health challenges or want to build a healthier lifestyle, our expert coaches are here to guide you every step of the way.
Mental Health Check-In - Prioritize your mental well-being with tools designed to support your emotional health. Access mindfulness content, emergency resources, and activities that promote stress management and relaxation.
Tracking and Insights - Track your progress toward your health goals with our intuitive trackers. Enter data manually or sync with your favorite devices or apps for automatic updates. View your progress in easy-to-read dashboards and use the insights to stay on top of your health journey.
Challenges - Stay motivated with fun activity challenges. Set a goal, push yourself to achieve it, and even enjoy a bit of healthy competition with leaderboards to track your progress.
Explore - Dive into educational content about medical conditions, disease prevention, and overall health. Whether you’re looking for reliable information or tips to improve your well-being, we’ve got you covered.
Personal Health Record - Managing your health information is easier than ever. Store immunizations, allergies, test results, and more in one secure place. You can even download and share your records with your healthcare providers.
Rewards - Healthy choices should be rewarding! Earn hearts and rewards for completing health activities, depending on how your plan is set up. If your employer includes rewards in your plan, you'll find them here.
Why You’ll Love MyActiveHealth
Because it’s tailored for you! Start by sharing your health goals and history, and we’ll create a personalized plan to help you succeed. Designed with members like you in mind, MyActiveHealth is easy to use, full of helpful tools, and puts the world of health resources right at your fingertips.
Thanks for downloading MyActiveHealth – we’re excited to be part of your journey to better health.

bluejetty:00018793:ios.description:
Over 20 Million Downloads Worldwide!
Play Star Chef, Best Cooking Simulation Game & Best of App Store!
Take your love of food and stir it in a cooking simulation game that celebrates delicious flavours. Run your own café and 5 star restaurant and experience the joy of building it from the ground up! Enjoy dicing fresh ingredients with experienced chefs while exploring your passion for cuisines across the world! 
Star Chef is an addictive cooking and restaurant management game that blends your love for food with the beautiful art of cooking! Run your own restaurant, cater to the insatiable desires of every customer through an expanding menu of worldly cuisines, and build the restaurant of your dreams! 
In your journey of becoming a Star Chef, explore special dishes from every continent with skilled staff having exceptional cooking skills, who handle state-of-the-art kitchen and restaurant appliances. This is your chance to follow your passion in a cooking game that’s exciting, fun, filled with food and offers a backyard to harvest the freshest crops! 
Realize your dream of becoming a Culinary Master! Play Star Chef: Cooking & Restaurant Game!

• PERSONALISED GAMEPLAY: Serve worldly cuisines by cooking and serving hungry FOODIES walking into your restaurant!  
• UPGRADES & CUSTOMIZATIONS: Wall decals, floor decors, fountains, and MANY MORE! 
• VEGETABLE GARDEN: Grow your own veggies in the BACKYARD of your restaurant to prepare fresh food!  
• CHEF’S STORE & FOOD TRUCK to trade cookbook secrets, veggies and YUMMY dishes! 
• CATERING SERVICE: Expand worldly cuisines BEYOND your restaurant by cooking and catering for events!  
• CHEF’S CIRCLE: Add friends on Facebook and Game Center to VISIT their restaurant and see what they've been cooking.

PROPERTY SEARCH

EMAIL SEARCH

CALL BLOCK

IDENTITY HUB
Keep track of your reports and stay informed about changes.
LISTS

bluejetty:00065473:ios.description:
Kufu Zaim is an easy, fun to use household account book app, perfect for our generation. Basic bookkeeping features are streamlined to make them as easy to use as possible, while various analysis tools help you understand your finances better by answering questions like "how much does everyone ELSE spend on food". There are even features such as “Update Stamp Rallies” that reward you for staying on track. The goal of this service is to make it fun to stay on top of your finances, and we will be working rigorously to release new features on an on-going basis to keep it that way.
========================
Reasons to use Kufu Zaim
========================
1. Easy to use user interface with attention to detail
2. Easy to use graphical analysis tools
3. Compare your expense trends with those of others
4. Track remaining funds for each budget item
5. Update Stamp Rally that rewards you for each update
6. Ability to register stores where you spend your money
7. Integration with Facebook
8. Detailed online help and guides to assist beginners
9. Make it easy to enter frequently used items with the Favorites feature
10. Multi-currency support (151 types of currencies)
========================
Features
========================
1. Record expenses
2. Record incomes
3. Associate stores with each expense item
4. Memos
5. Update Stamp Rally to track updates
6. Set budgets for each expense category
7. Customizable icons
8. Graphical analysis of your income and expense
9. Expense item based reports
10. Personal profile
11. Comparison of expense trends with those of other Zaim users
12. Comparison of expense trends with those of other users based on location
13. Save favorite input settings
14. Create entries from saved favorites
15. Create entries from past entries
========================
About the Premium service
========================
1. Input quickly and hide advertising
2. Multiple accounts management
3. Adding the balance graph
4. Analyze your insurances, loans and welfare benefits
[Plan]
Monthly plan
Automatically renewed on a monthly basis starting from the contract date.
Yearly plan
Automatically renewed on a Yearly basis starting from the contract date.
[How to update]
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24h prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.Unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase.
[Charging method]
We will charge to your iTunes account.
[How to withdraw from the Premium service ]
Unsubscribe by the following procedure.
[iOS 11 and later]
1. Open the App Store app
2. Select "Today" tab and the button on the top right
3. Select the area displayed your account
4. Select "Subscriptions"
You can also confirm the date of the next charge on the same window.
* If you cancel early, you can continue to use current premium plan until your account automatically finish the premium services at the end of your current billing period. You will not be charged again unless you restart Zaim Premium.
* Please note that you cannot complete the cancel of the automatic update of the Premium service from the Kufu Zaim app and web sites.
[Privacy policy] 
https://kufu.co.jp/service-privacypolicy/
* Japanese only
[Terms of the service for the Premium service] 
https://content.zaim.net/legal/premium
* Japanese only
=====================
Currencies supported
=====================
We support 151 types of currencies.
US Dollar, Canadian Dollar, Yuan, Yen, Pound, Australian Dollar, New Zealand Dollar, Hong Kong Dollar, Taiwan Dollar, Singapore Dollar, Won, Peso, Baht, Dong, Ruble, Rupee, Real, Rand, Sheqel, Ringgit, Philippine Peso, Indonesian Rupiah, Mexican Peso, Afghani, Lek, Dram, Antillean guilder, etc.

bluejetty:00035144:ios.description:
Clean up your iPhone and organize your storage smarter with CleanX.
From duplicate photos and similar videos to large files, overflowing inboxes, and messy contact lists, CleanX helps you remove unnecessary clutter, free up storage space, and keep your iPhone organized with less effort. Whether your iPhone storage full warning keeps appearing or you simply want to clean out your phone faster, CleanX helps make storage management easier and more organized.
REMOVE DUPLICATE PHOTOS & CLEAN VIDEOS FASTER
Your gallery can quickly fill up with duplicate photos, similar images, repeated videos, screenshots, bursts, and unnecessary media that take up valuable storage space.
Remove duplicate photos and similar images, clear repeated videos, sort large files by size, and free up storage space more efficiently without manually searching through your gallery.
SWIPE THROUGH PHOTOS TO CLEAN UP IN SECONDS
Organizing your gallery should feel simple and natural.
Swipe through photos to quickly decide what to keep and what to remove without spending hours scrolling through your camera roll. If you are looking for how to clear up space on iPhone, CleanX helps simplify the entire cleanup process.
FIND LARGE FILES & FREE UP STORAGE SPACE
Large videos and storage-heavy files can silently consume your phone storage. Get more storage on iPhone by identifying large and unnecessary files taking up space in your gallery.
REDUCE VIDEO SIZE WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY
Save storage without losing important memories.
Compress videos to reduce file sizes while maintaining visual quality and choose exactly which videos you want to optimize.
CLEAN UP EMAIL CLUTTER IN SECONDS
An overloaded inbox can become difficult to manage.
CleanX helps you remove spam, promotional emails, and unnecessary messages so your mailbox feels cleaner, lighter, and easier to organize.
ORGANIZE CONTACTS & BACK THEM UP SECURELY
Merge duplicate contacts, remove unnecessary contact information, create secure backups, and restore previous contact lists anytime with less effort.
KEEP PERSONAL FILES SAFE & PRIVATE
Keep personal photos and videos protected inside a secure private space designed for sensitive content you want to keep separate from your gallery.
ADD CHARGING ANIMATIONS & USEFUL HOME WIDGETS
Make your iPhone feel more personal with stylish charging animations and practical Home Screen widgets for battery tracking, storage usage, and faster access to cleanup tools.
PRIVATE, SAFE & DESIGNED FOR CONTROL
Your privacy and control always come first.
CleanX is designed to help you clean, organize, and optimize your iPhone safely while keeping your personal data protected and fully under your control.

bluejetty:00041589:ios.description:
Wild Jacks : Card Game - Online Multiplayer Sequence Card & Dice Game
Welcome to Wild Jacks : Card Game, the ultimate online multiplayer strategy game where cards, dice, and smart decision-making come together. Challenge real players, compete with friends, create private rooms, and build winning sequences in exciting multiplayer battles.
Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced strategist, Wild Jacks offers a fun, competitive, and rewarding gameplay experience that is easy to learn and challenging to master.
FEATURES
Online Multiplayer Battles – Play against real players from around the world.
Card & Dice Modes – Enjoy both classic sequence card gameplay and exciting dice battles.
Friends System – Add friends, send friend requests, view online status, and challenge them anytime.
Private Rooms – Create private matches, share room codes, and play exclusively with friends and family.
Strategic Gameplay – Use planning, timing, and smart moves to complete sequences before your opponents.
Jokers & Wild Cards – Gain an advantage with powerful special cards.
Rematch Feature – Continue the competition instantly with quick rematches.
Animated Emojis & Quick Chat – Express yourself during matches with fun reactions and messages.
Multiple Tables & Matchmaking – Choose your preferred table and compete with players worldwide.
Daily Rewards & Daily Spin – Collect free rewards every day.
Daily Challenges – Complete missions to earn coins, experience, and rewards. 
Detailed Statistics – Track wins, sequences completed, streaks, and overall performance.
Beautiful Themes – Enjoy visually appealing boards and card designs.
Welcome Rewards – New players receive exciting bonuses to get started. 
HOW TO PLAY
CARD GAME
1. Draw and play cards to place chips on the game board.
2. Create sequences of five chips horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
3. Use jokers and wild cards strategically.
4. Block opponents from completing their sequences.
5. Complete the required number of sequences before your opponent.
6. Win the match and climb the rankings.
DICE GAME 
1. Highest opening roll gets the first turn.
2. Roll the dice and place your chip on the matching number.
3. Roll 10 to remove an opponent’s chip.
4. Roll 11 to place a chip on any empty space.
5. Roll 2 or 12 to earn an extra turn.
6. Create sequences and outsmart your opponent.
7. Complete the required sequence first to win.
WHY PLAY Wild Jacks?
Real-Time Multiplayer Gameplay
Strategic Card & Dice Battles
Play With Friends Anytime
Private Rooms & Friendly Challenges
Competitive Online Matchmaking
Daily Rewards & Progression System
Quick Chat & Animated Reactions
Easy to Learn, Difficult to Master
If you enjoy strategy games, card games, board games, multiplayer challenges, and competitive online gameplay, Wild Jacks : Card Game is the perfect game for you.
Download now, challenge players worldwide, create private rooms with friends, and become the ultimate Wild Jack!

bluejetty:00087064:ios.summary:

Birds chirping, the sound of trees, and the fireplace all add up
bluejetty:00087064:ios.description:
The lakeside and mountain peaks spread out before your eyes, as well as the open-air guest room bath with free-flowing spring water, and the balcony overlooking the lakeside.
Birds chirping, the sound of trees, and the fireplace all add up to a quality stay.
Welcome to our hotel in a hidden corner of the world, where sunlight gently seeps in.
We have specially prepared the "Lake View" room for you, which is the corner suite on the top floor of the hotel.
Please enjoy an extraordinary experience in a room surrounded by lush greenery and the beautiful lakeside.
【Features】
・Adorable characters enjoyable for children of young ages.
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!
【Provide】
Music is VFR：http://musicisvfr.com
Pocket Sound : http://pocket-se.info/
icons8：https://icons8.com/
びたちー素材館

bluejetty:00033603:ios.summary:
Transform Your Fitness Journey with WeBurn
Embrace a new era of fitness with WeBurn – the innovative 7-minute workout app specifically designed for women. Tailored to meet the unique needs and challenges of today's woman, WeBurn offers eff
bluejetty:00033603:ios.description:
Transform Your Fitness Journey with WeBurn
Embrace a new era of fitness with WeBurn – the innovative 7-minute workout app specifically designed for women. Tailored to meet the unique needs and challenges of today's woman, WeBurn offers efficient, high-intensity interval training (HIIT) exercises and personalized workout plans. Experience the benefits of a fitness coach from the comfort of your home.
Why WeBurn Stands Out
In today's fast-paced world, balancing work, personal life, and fitness can be overwhelming. Traditional fitness solutions often fall short, being either too costly, time-consuming, or inconvenient. WeBurn is the game-changer you’ve been waiting for:
– Cost-effective: Say goodbye to expensive gym memberships.
– Time-Saving: Each power-packed workout is just 7 minutes.
– Flexible and Portable: Exercise anywhere, anytime, fitting seamlessly into your busy life.
Get Fit, Fast
With WeBurn, dive into a world of fitness designed for the modern woman:
– Quick Calorie Burn: Accelerate weight loss with targeted workouts.
– Total Body Toning: Sculpt and shape with exercises for arms, abs, buttocks, and legs.
– Customizable Intensity: Personalize your exercise intensity for maximum results.
– Adaptable Fitness Plans: Tailor your journey towards muscle building, weight loss, or maintenance.
– Integrate Exercise with Ease: Perfect for fitting into tight schedules.
– Energizing Workout Music: Enhance motivation with exciting tunes.
Diverse Workout Programs
Explore a wide range of workout options to keep your routine fresh and effective:
– Full Body
– Abs & Core
– Legs & Glutes
– Butt
– Upper Body
– Cardio
Customize Your Challenge
Adjust each workout to match your fitness level with four difficulty settings, each consisting of 12 intervals:
– Easy: 15s exercise + 25s rest
– Moderate: 20s exercise + 20s rest
– Challenging: 25s exercise + 15s rest
– Intense: 30s exercise + 10s rest
Free Features
– Access basic workouts and plans.
– Track your progress with the workout calendar.
– Stay on track with workout reminders.
– Sync with Apple Health for accurate calorie and progress tracking.
Premium Features
– Enjoy personalized workout routines.
– Get motivated with hand-picked workout music.
– Gain unlimited access to all workouts.
– Use the app offline, anywhere, anytime.
Flexible Subscriptions
Choose from three Premium subscription plans:
– 1 month
– 3 months
– 12 months
Payment is processed via your App Store account. WeBurn Premium automatically renews at the end of each period unless cancelled 24 hours prior. Manage your subscription easily in your App Store account. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at: 
• Privacy Policy: https://kodeon.ai/privacy-policy
• Terms of Use: https://kodeon.ai/terms-of-use
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Join WeBurn Today
Step into a world where fitness aligns perfectly with your lifestyle. Download WeBurn and start your journey towards a healthier, more empowered you!

"Clear Picture" is an AI-powered photo restoration application designed for users seeking to quickly and effortlessly enhance photo quality.
Whether you wish to fix blurry photos, improve overall quality, adjust lighting, add color to your images, or transform low-resolution old photos into crystal-clear HD images, "Clear Picture - Photo Clearer" is the perfect solution.

- Detail enhancement for sharper images
- Adjustment of exposure levels to correct lighting
- Correction of color fading or variation
- Removal of scratches and yellow tones from old photos
- Colorization of old black and white photos

bluejetty:00039677:ios.description:
Your friends love you, but will they read thousands of text messages for you?
Is your situationship going to last?
What really went wrong with your ex?
Your texts reveal more about you than you think. Amori's AI dating coaches analyze your conversations for personalized dating insights and matchmaking.
MEET OUR AI DATING COACHES
Pick from our selection of AI dating coaches that give different types of advice based on their personality. Christie the Blunt Bestie tells it like it is, Ethan the Wingman pumps you up, Tabitha the Wise Aunt gives advice that feels like a warm hug, and Grace the Love Scholar backs her advice with facts and research.
ANALYZE YOUR TEXT CONVERSATIONS
Upload your conversations directly from iMessage or WhatsApp, or using a screen recording from any app, to run a comprehensive relationship analysis: Relationship Health Status, Attachment Styles, Red Flags, and more.
GET PERSONALIZED DATING INSIGHTS
Chat 1:1 with your dating coach to ask specific questions about any of your relationships, and even attach screenshots. Did what I said last night freak them out? Are they still in love with their ex? What did it mean when they sent this? -- Amori is your copilot to help navigate your dating life.
AI MATCHMAKING THAT ACTUALLY KNOWS YOU
*NEW* Turn your coach into an AI matchmaker -- they'll get to know you beyond just a profile. By learning from your conversations, personality, and relationship patterns, we'll introduce you to matches who actually fit.
SET GOALS & CHECK IN DAILY
Choose a custom plan recommended by your coach and reflect with daily check in questions. These questions become more personalized as you continue chatting with your coach daily.
Subscribe for unlimited access to premium analyses, unlimited chats with your coach, and more.
Have questions or feedback? We would love to hear from you at info@amori.app!
Terms of Service: https://amori.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://amori.app/privacy.html

Key Features of Bass Booster App:
Dynamic Bass Boost: Intensify the low-end frequencies for a deeper, richer bass that resonates.
Advanced Equalizer: Tailor your audio with multiple EQ presets or create your own custom settings.
Volume Enhancement: Boost sound levels for a more powerful and immersive listening experience.
High-Quality Sound Boost: Experience crystal-clear audio without distortion at high volumes for your music.
User-Friendly Interface: Navigate effortlessly through the EQ Booster to find your perfect sound setup.
Dive into a world of sonic excellence with Equalizer Booster App, the premier Bass Booster for iPhone. Our app which also works as a Sound Amplifier is not just about amplifying sound; it’s about sculpting it to perfection. With a comprehensive collection of presets for music, you can effortlessly switch between soundscapes tailored for every genre and mood with perfect speaker volume.
Preset Highlights of Boost Equalizer:
Concert Hall: Feel the live vibe as if you’re front row at a concert.
Acoustic Serenity: Enjoy the subtle nuances of acoustic strings and vocals.
Deep Bass: Unleash the power of sub-bass frequencies for a ground-shaking experience.
Vocal Booster: Ensure vocals stand out clearly in any mix in our Bass Booster App.
Electronic Edge: Give electronic music the punch and clarity it demands.
Each preset is meticulously crafted by sound engineers to enhance specific elements of your music. Whether you’re looking to boost the bass in hip-hop tracks or bring clarity to classical pieces, our Equalizer Booster and Volume Booster features work in harmony to deliver unparalleled audio quality.
Other Features:
Powerful Bass Booster: Feel the intensity of deep, resonant bass with our sophisticated bass enhancement technology.
Seamless iTunes Integration: Access your entire iTunes library directly within the app for a unified music experience.
Cloud Compatibility: Download your favorite tracks from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud Drive, or via Wi-Fi Transfer.

bluejetty:00071700:ios.description:
لعبة صقر الصحراء من اقوى العاب سباق الخيل الجديدة وتعتبر هذه اللعبة هى بالفعل احدث العاب سباق الخيل المناسبة للجميع الاعمار بنات ، اطفال و شباب وخصوصا محبى الخيل والفروسية . او حتى هواة مشاهدة مباريات رياضة سباقات الخيول العالميه ولا شك ان اجود وافضل انواع الخيول موجودة في هذه العبه.
تحدى اصدقائك والعب كي تكون افضل فارس .قم باختيار حصانك المفضل من حراج و سوق الخيل .
تحتوي هذه اللعبة على عديد من الخرائط و المستويات برسومات عالية و تعتبر من اقوى العاب سباق . يمكنك تحدي اصدقائك او اللعب منفرد ومشاركة النتيجة مع اصحابك. وتاتي هذه اللعبة بشكل 3d.
ان كنت من محبي العاب السباق و سيارات والعاب الهجوله و تفحيط و درفت فان لعبه صقر الصحراء هي افضل خيار لك وخصوصا انا تحتوى على افكار جديدة .
رسومات بجودة عالية
استمتع برسومات ثلاثية الأبعاد متطورة مع بيئات تم إنشاؤها بواقعية واستمتاع بمشاهدة الخيل و حصان بتفاصيل مثيرة للدهشة.
أنماط لعب تناسب كل مزاج
اشعر بالحماس في طريق من اتجاه واحد أو من اتجاهين، اندفع في لعبة سريعة في محاربة الوقت أو قم بركوب الحصن بهدوء في طريق حر.
زوايا كاميرا متعددة
قم بالسباق عبر حركة المرور مع الكاميرا العلوية أو الخلفية، كل زاوية كاميرا توفر تجربة قيادة فريدة من نوعها.ريد.
تم تطويرها لتكون اقوى لعبة لهذا العام و ميزاتها :
- العديد من المستويات والمراحل.
- خيل مميزة بتصميم واقعي
- تصوير داخلي
-زوايا كاميرا متعددة
- افضل خيل للهجوله والتطعيس.
- هجولة بدون شرطه او حواجز
- تطويف وهجولة 
- مرحلة حرة لتستمتع بها كيفما شئت
اكتشف سر حب الملايين حول العالم لهذه اللعبة الممتعة،
شارك اصحابك المتعة والمرح في هذه اللعبة الصعبة للعديد من اللاعبين فهل انت منهم؟
لعبة بسيطة ولكنها تسبب الإدمان وهي مناسبة لك ان كنت من محبي العاب شرطه وتحفيط , حرامي.
متعة وتحدي بشكل فوري بدون نت جديدة كليا.
بدون تسجيل٫ بدون تعقيدات٫ ابدأ اللعب مباشرة واستمتع
لعبة مجانية في العالم العربي، جربوا اللعبة ولا تنسوا تقييمها لتستمر التحديث

bluejetty:00014387:ios.name: Liquid UI Client for SAP
bluejetty:00014387:ios.summary: Liquid UI for SAP empowers your IT(/users) to ADAPT your existing SAP infrastructure by providing instant mobile access – a complete, comprehensive and native SAP GUI for your device. Its direct connectivity to S/4HANA, ERP or ECC facilitat
bluejetty:00014387:ios.description:
Liquid UI for SAP empowers your IT(/users) to ADAPT your existing SAP infrastructure by providing instant mobile access – a complete, comprehensive and native SAP GUI for your device. Its direct connectivity to S/4HANA, ERP or ECC facilitates mobility without the need to reprogram processes or redevelop z* transactions or recreate transactions in Fiori. 
In addition, with Liquid UI you can also FLEXIBLY innovate your SAP transactions on iOS as per your business requirements along with your screen real estate needs. Furthermore, enjoy the same SECURITY that you get with SAP because of the app’s native connectivity and support to TLS encryption over wirelessly transmitted data.
Key features of Liquid UI for SAP
• Rule-based barcode integration – Populate multiple fields and program actions like auto-enter or auto-tabbing using a barcode.
• Notifications and badges – Manage SAP processes and auto-assign tasks to individuals with all the required context.
• Single sign-on support – Login to SAP using Windows Active Directory with Kerberos authentication, SAP Portal, or SAP Trust.
• World-class security & encryption – Have more control over wirelessly transmitted data between the app and your SAP.
• Automate processes – Automate your SAP transactions to eliminate slow, manually dependent and error-prone processes. 
• Attach instantly via Service For Objects – Instantly attach an image or a video file to your SAP transaction from your device.
• Integrate with web services – Connect with external programs like Salesforce, Excel, PDF, make RFC calls, interact with web service or integrate to databases like Oracle and SQL.
• Electronic signature support, Language localization, On-the-go printing, GPS coordinates support and more.
NOTE: Download this FREE client software on your iOS device and connect to your SAP TODAY to evaluate the user experience and functionality provided by Liquid UI.
Work faster and smarter across many SAP processes
Grow all parts of your business with our complete enterprise platform. Manage processes from Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Inventory Management (IM), Materials Management (MM), Warehouse Management (WM), Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Plant Maintenance (PM), Quality Management (QM), Project Systems (PS), Human Capital Management (HCM), Basis System, etc.
About Liquid UI Technology
Liquid UI is devised to make your existing SAP infrastructure adaptable to advanced technologies like IoT. You can immediately extend your SAP ERP to iOS without reprogramming. Also, you can flexibly innovate your SAP screens to make it simpler and more intuitive. Liquid UI technology also enabled you to deliver specific content based on your business needs. In addition, Liquid UI provides the same security which you get with SAP because of its native connectivity and support to TLS encryption. Thus making your SAP more robust, intelligent, and proficient.

bluejetty:00073446:ios.name: ParkHouston
bluejetty:00073446:ios.summary: The ParkHouston app, powered by ParkMobile, gives you a smarter way to park in Houston. Easily pay for on-street and off-street parking right from your mobile device. You can also reserve parking ahead of time in lots, garages, venues, airp
bluejetty:00073446:ios.description:
The ParkHouston app, powered by ParkMobile, gives you a smarter way to park in Houston. Easily pay for on-street and off-street parking right from your mobile device. You can also reserve parking ahead of time in lots, garages, venues, airports, and universities across the country. You can use the ParkHouston app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, and more.
Why Use ParkHouston?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Reserve parking spots ahead of time to save time and money
• Use the app in over 3000 locations coast-to-coast including venues, airports, and universities
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the ParkHouston app and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the ParkHouston app
How It Works
On-Street and Off-Street Parking:
• Enter the zone number on the posted signs around the meter
• Select the amount of time you want to park and confirm your information
• Touch the “Start Parking” button to begin your parking session
• Extend time in the app if you are running late
Parking Reservations:
• Search for the area where you want to park and select the specific parking location
• Choose the date/time and complete your reservation
• Follow the instructions in your confirmation to redeem at the parking facility
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find my car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked
• Turn-by-turn directions to the parking garage where you reserved your spot
• Multiple payment methods available
About ParkMobile
ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider of parking payment solutions in the United States, helping over 40 million people easily find, reserve, and pay for parking from their mobile devices.
Looking for Help?
At ParkMobile, we’re serious about customer service. We process nearly 500,000 parking transactions every day and we know that every now and then, something might go wrong. If you have an issue, we will do everything we can to make it right. Our customer service is 24/7/365. If you need help, here’s how to get in touch with us:
Web: https://ParkMobile.io/
Email: helpdesk@ParkMobile.io
Online Help Center: https://ParkMobile.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
Video Tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkFsfUAHrnUc5jOm9XtjOmmJQt4YTTCyA
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ParkMobile
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParkMobile/
