bluejetty:00016591:ios.description:
Come to Jewel Block Puzzle Classic, your task is filling the blocks in vertical or horizontal and when they disappear, you will get the points. The more rows are destroyed, the higher the score you get. The goal of this game is the highest score you get at the end of the game.
In addition to the traditional Block puzzle gameplay, you will also encounter brand-new original COMBO gameplay. Drag and drop blocks onto the board to fill a row or column to complete elimination. If you want to get high marks, you must use your logic and skill. Test your IQ and train your brain in Jewel Block Puzzle Classic!
You will lose if there is no space on the board to fill the next blocks. Focusing, viewing and arranging the blocks logically.
The game is totally free, unlimited time, you can entertain in the colorful world and the lively sound of Jewel Block Puzzle Classic whenever you want. Take a break at any time with this puzzle game!

bluejetty:00032497:ios.description:
New Living Translation (NLT) Bible with audio narration, AI Bible Chat, daily verses, study plans, devotionals, Prayer Wall, and offline reading.
The New Living Translation (NLT) presents Scripture in clear, natural, everyday English. Read and explore God's Word with helpful tools designed to make Bible reading and study simple and meaningful.
Read, listen, highlight, study, and pray every day — no account needed to start reading, with offline access to all 66 books.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND INSIDE
• COMPLETE NLT BIBLE — Read all 66 books of the Old and New Testament in clear, easy-to-understand language.
• AUDIO BIBLE — Listen to Bible chapters at home, while traveling, walking, resting, or whenever you want to hear God's Word.
• AI BIBLE CHAT — Ask questions about Scripture, passages, biblical themes, faith, or Christian life and get easy-to-understand answers based on the Bible.
• DAILY VERSE & PRAYER — Start your day with an inspiring Bible verse and prayer.
• PRAYER WALL — Share prayer requests, pray for others, and be part of a community praying together.
• HIGHLIGHTS, NOTES & BOOKMARKS — Save important verses, add bookmarks, highlights, and personal notes while you read.
• OFFLINE BIBLE — Read Scripture without an internet connection or creating an account.
• STUDY PLANS — Build a regular Bible reading habit with guided reading and study plans.
• DAILY DEVOTIONAL — Spend a few minutes each day reading and reflecting on God's Word.
• HOME SCREEN WIDGET — Keep Scripture visible throughout your day.
• BIBLE SEARCH — Quickly find verses, words, passages, and topics across Scripture.
READ, LISTEN & STUDY
Read a chapter during your quiet time, listen to Bible audio throughout your day, save meaningful verses, or continue reading where you left off.
When you have questions, AI Bible Chat can help you understand passages and explore biblical topics in more detail.
PRAY TOGETHER
Prayer Wall gives you a place to share prayer requests and pray for others in the community.
Reporting and blocking options are available to help keep the Prayer Wall safe and respectful.
GROW IN GOD'S WORD
Whether you want to understand a difficult passage, strengthen your faith, or build a daily Bible habit, NLT Bible gives you the tools to read, listen, study, pray, and reflect.
Follow study plans, listen to Scripture, save important verses, ask Bible questions, or simply continue reading where you left off.
SCRIPTURE FOR EVERY SEASON
Explore God's Word during Christmas, Easter, Good Friday, Lent, and other meaningful moments of the Christian year with Scripture, reflection, and prayer.
FOR EVERYONE
Whether you are discovering the Bible for the first time, returning to God's Word, studying with your family, or serving in church ministry, NLT Bible makes daily Bible reading simple and meaningful.
PREMIUM — OPTIONAL
Optional premium plans provide access to additional study features and an ad-free experience.
Auto-renewable subscription options are available. Lifetime Study is also available as a one-time purchase.
AI features may use credits or have usage limits depending on your plan. Lifetime Study does not include unlimited AI usage.
Prices, plans, and included features are shown in the app before purchase and may vary by country or region.
PRIVACY & SUPPORT

https://bibleoffice.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service:
https://bibleoffice.com/terms_conditions.html
Support:
https://bibleoffice.com/contact.php
Email: support@bibleoffice.com
Download NLT Bible today and make God's Word part of every day.
God bless you.

bluejetty:00024158:ios.description:
Rooooaaarrrrr!!
The Bibi Lion roars in the Savanna calling all the animals together to organize a big party. The Bibi.Pet party has landed in Africa and is bringing with it lots of fun and lots of educational activities for kids.
There’s the hippopotamus painting with colored balls, the giraffe with balancing activities and obviously the lion looking for his crown.
And lots of other games: puzzles, numbers, pairing and sorting.
And as always, Bibi.Pet will accompany you as you discover all the educational activities available.
Suitable for ages 2 to 5 and designed together with experts from the educational field.
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- Complete the puzzles
- Have fun coloring
- Educational matching activities 
- Use Logic
- Play with music
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00026317:ios.summary: Welcome to Kidduca 3D - an interactive, multiplayer educational game where kids can learn new languages, develop essential skills in math, writing, and reading, recognize colors, solve fun logic puzzles, and enjoy exciting racing games! Kid
bluejetty:00026317:ios.description:
Welcome to Kidduca 3D - an interactive, multiplayer educational game where kids can learn new languages, develop essential skills in math, writing, and reading, recognize colors, solve fun logic puzzles, and enjoy exciting racing games! Kidduca 3D is designed to engage young learners with a variety of fun and educational activities.
Key Educational Features:
3D LEARNING GAMES FOR KIDS
Kidduca 3D offers over 90 educational levels filled with 400+ interactive elements, including letters, numbers, shapes, words, animals, and vehicles. Kids will improve their language skills, practice counting, learn to read, and solve engaging puzzles. This interactive learning experience is perfect for boys and girls ages 2 to 7!
NUMBERS & MATH LEARNING GAMES
Make learning numbers fun with engaging math activities! These interactive games build a strong foundation in counting and introduce basic arithmetic in an easy-to-understand way.
SHAPES, COLORS & CREATIVE COLORING ACTIVITIES
Through interactive drawing and coloring games, kids will learn to identify shapes and colors while enhancing their logical thinking, fine motor skills, and creativity. These activities are ideal for early cognitive development in children ages 2 to 5.
ALPHABET & WORD LEARNING GAMES
Kids ages 2 to 7 can explore letters, words, and sounds with interactive alphabet games and flashcards. These activities build strong early literacy and writing skills.
LOGIC PUZZLES & SORTING GAMES
Boost your child’s critical thinking with fun sorting games and logic puzzles! Kids will sort objects by size, color, and shape, strengthening their problem-solving abilities and cognitive growth.
MULTIPLAYER GAMES FOR KIDS
Kidduca 3D offers a fun multiplayer experience where kids can see other players and interact using cheerful emojis! This feature makes learning even more exciting, encouraging children to explore Kidduca 3D together.
EDUCATIONAL CAR RACING GAMES
Make learning even more fun with customizable car racing games! Kids can design their own cars and tracks, improving spatial awareness, hand-eye coordination, and strategic thinking.
WHY CHOOSE KIDDUCA 3D?
Kidduca 3D provides a safe and enriching environment where kids can learn while having fun. Each level is narrated by native speakers, helping children learn correct pronunciation. The game seamlessly blends education and entertainment, making it perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, and early learners!
DOWNLOAD KIDDUCA 3D TODAY!
Give your child the best start – download Kidduca 3D today and start the learning adventure! Whether it’s language learning, math practice, writing improvement, reading comprehension, color exploration, puzzle-solving, or thrilling car racing, Kidduca 3D has it all.

bluejetty:00046793:ios.description:
City Block Jam – Solve Puzzles, Build Your Dream City!
Are you ready for a puzzle adventure like no other? City Block Jam takes the classic sliding block puzzle game to the next level by blending brain-teasing puzzles, color matching challenges, and strategic city-building fun! Every puzzle you solve not only sharpens your logic and reflex skills but also brings your dream city to life.
Think, Solve, Build!
In City Block Jam, you’ll dive into addictive, casual brain training as you slide blocks, overcome obstacles, and complete uniquely challenging levels. With every move, you earn coins to upgrade your city and unlock exciting new areas, turning simple block puzzles into a vibrant urban adventure.
Game Highlights:
-A Fresh Take on Puzzle Gaming: This isn’t just another block puzzle game! Every solved level in this mobile puzzle game rewards you with coins to invest in your city’s growth.
-Hundreds of Mind-Teasing Puzzles: Enjoy a wide variety of brain-teasing puzzles that blend logic, reflexes, and creative planning in a colorful block matching challenge.
-Unlock & Expand Your City: Use your rewards to build and customize your metropolis, making each win even more satisfying.
-Strategic & Addictive Gameplay: Every move counts in this sliding block puzzle game that combines casual brain training with a time-based puzzle challenge.
-Stunning Visuals & Immersive Experience: The game’s vibrant graphics and smooth controls create a visually engaging, ASMR-like experience for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.
-Daily Challenges & Exciting Rewards: Return every day for special missions, exclusive rewards, and new opportunities to grow your dream city!
How to Play:
-Slide the blocks to clear paths and match colors in this captivating block puzzle game.
-Solve each color matching puzzle efficiently to earn coins and bonuses.
-Use your coins to upgrade, build, and customize your city.
-Overcome increasingly challenging puzzles and time-based obstacles to unlock new city features!
Why You’ll Love City Block Jam:
-A perfect blend of addictive, brain-teasing puzzles and creative city-building.
-A rewarding progression system—watch your city flourish as you master every sliding block puzzle challenge.
-An engaging and relaxing puzzle adventure designed for puzzle enthusiasts and city-building fans alike.
If you love a mix of logic, creativity, and fun, then City Block Jam is your go-to mobile puzzle game. Play now and start solving puzzles to build the city of your dreams!

bluejetty:00086815:ios.description:
Brave Brain is a quiz & trivia game that lets you look at familiar and unfamiliar places on the world map, test your knowledge in quizzes and learn lots of interesting facts!
The game is fully blind-friendly and supports VoiceOver.
Choose a country, location or place and try to master the quiz questions. You have 30 seconds to answer and one of the four choices is always correct.
The correct answer will earn you additional coins for the game. Wrong answer? Redeem yourself using diamonds. The more correct answers you get, the higher you climb on the ladder of those who aren't afraid to think.
And when do you win? Whenever you get it right! This quiz & trivia game has no definitive end, just like knowledge of the world. You can go back and expand your horizons whenever you have a moment.
This version of the fun quiz and trivia game has many advantages: a hand painted and beautiful art style, thousands of exciting questions, excellent sound track and sound effects will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the places you visit in the game. And this makes it one of the best free quiz games.
Game Features:
 - Enjoy playing solo or compare your knowledge with others in leaderboards.
 - More than 10000 quiz & trivia questions from all continents and fields of knowledge.
 - The game is completely barrier-free: you can play without sight or hearing! (screen reader VoiceOver is supported)
 - Hand-painted art style.
 - Immersive soundtrack.
 - The game is fully playable in the free version, with money you can buy in-game currency, personal avatars and other bonuses.
Quiz topics:
 - Geography
 - History
 - Politics
 - Culture
 - Sport
 - Science and inventions
 - Technology and engineering
 - Demography
 - Personalities
 - Lifestyle and trends
 - Art history and facts
 - Architecture and landmarks
 - Food and cooking
 - Fashion and popular brands
Got five minutes? Stop scrolling and send your brain on an interesting journey with this quiz & trivia game!

The beautiful seaside of Aegean Ocean, the mysterious rain forest, the exotic Egypt or the South Pole? Let’s pack up your suitcase and head to the airport! 

Papo Town: Travel stimulates a real trip, and you could experience different sceneries, cultures and customs of different countries, explore the mysteries and surprises of nature! The game includes five scenes including the airport, ancient Egypt, Aegean seaside, the south pole and the Amazon rain forest! Enjoy the fun of discovery! 

Purple Pink the Bunny, Luca the Dog and other 13 lovely Papo friends are here to play with you! Drag the animals to anywhere in the scene, and start to create the story of your own!

The most exciting part is to find out the hidden clues, and intrigue the mysterious settings. You may get rich rewards! Don't miss them!

Have a good time in Papo Town and have a nice trip!

Features
	Simulate a real trip!
	Vivid animations and sound effects!
	Play with 13 cute animals!
	Various cute outfits!
	Support multi-player mode. Play with friends! 
	Open exploration! No rules and no limit!
	Discover hidden rewards!
	Hundreds of interactive props!
	Inspire imagination and creativity!
	No Wi-Fi required. It could be played anywhere!

This version of Papo Town: Travel is free to download. Unlock more rooms through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com


[About Papo World]
Papo World aims to create a relaxed, harmonious and enjoyable game play environment to stimulate children's curiosity and interest in learning. 
Focused on games and supplemented by fun animated episodes, our preschool digital educational products are tailored for children. 
Through experiential and immersive gameplay, kids could develop healthy living habits and arise curiosity and creativity. Discover and inspire talents of every child!

bluejetty:00031731:ios.description:
Stay connected to Cincinnati with the WLWT News 5 app!
Be the first to know about breaking news, weather updates, and top stories in Cincinnati and the surrounding area. With the WLWT News 5 app, you’ll have real-time news, sports highlights, traffic alerts, and entertainment updates – all at your fingertips. Download for free today and experience news like never before.
Nearly 200,000 users rely on the WLWT News 5 app to stay informed about what’s happening in Cincinnati. Join the community today and see why it’s a must-have for local news.
LIVE NEWS
 - Get instant push notifications for breaking news.
 - Launch full live newscasts using the Nowcast bar.
 - Catch up on the latest newscast with On Demand playback.
 REAL-TIME WEATHER
 - Stay updated with current weather conditions and hourly forecasts.
 - Plan ahead with a detailed 10-day outlook and weekend forecast.
 - Zoom in to street-level detail with an interactive radar.
 - Receive critical weather warnings and expert videocasts.
COMMUNITY FOCUSED
 - Submit news tips, photos, and videos directly to our newsroom.
 - Share stories easily via email, text, or social media.
 - Discover live traffic incidents, local articles, and crime reports with the interactive Happening Near You map.
 - Stay informed with in-depth coverage of local stories and events that matter to your community.
 - Keep up with the Bengals, Reds, FC Cincinnati and your local college and high school teams with the latest coverage and highlights.
STAY AHEAD WITH WLWT NEWS 5
Whether it's breaking news, live weather updates, or the latest from the world of sports and entertainment, the WLWT News 5 app delivers the information that matters most to you.
DOWNLOAD NOW AND STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR COMMUNITY.
Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

bluejetty:00024713:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00024713:ios.description:
Tick Tack Toe glow is a free classic puzzle game, also known as Noughts and Crosses. It is the best digital edition of the classic paper-and-pencil game that anyone & everyone can play online or offline.
Get more childlike innocence, Get more joy! Revisit the classics, great Happiness. If you are an adult get your favorite childhood memories of Tic Tac Toe which you may play physically.
Tic Tac Toe Game features:
- Play in your iPhone and iPad. Or play with your friends & family - Singleplayer & Multiplayer support
- Various options of ‘rows x columns’ grid - 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 8x8
- Perfect software-based Artificial Intelligence (AI) within the game. That decides the difficulty for you, as you continue to play.
- Custom place mark (X or O) options - ‘align’. It’s not that easy to win!
- Easy to play hard to master gameplay
- Elegant fresh screen with glowing designs
HOW TO PLAY?
- Two players alternate, marking one empty space (box) at a time.
- The player attempts to placemarks (X or O) in a sequence, unlike an SOS game. It can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal (slantwise). Make 3, 4, 5, or 8 scores (as decided by you).
- The player who makes the most sequences (either of Os or Xs) WINS! 
Not everyone can beat the AI engine, can you? Try single-player mode and level up your logical thinking & brain skills! 
The AI for this puzzle game is one of the best you will see. It adapts to your playing style and is very unpredictable. The most played game is sometimes also known as X and O, and “Cat's Game”.
That’s everyone can enjoy the game at any time and anywhere! Because of the simplicity of this Tic Tac Toe, it is often used as a pedagogical tool. For teaching the concepts of good sportsmanship and the branch of artificial intelligence. It’s easy to play, easier to experience the challenge!
Tic Tac Toe have different names:
- X & O
- O-X OR X-O
- Tick-tack-toe in the US and Canada.
- Naughts & crosses or noughts and crosses in Asia (India, Pakistan, etc), Europe (United Kingdom, Germany, etc), South Africa, New Zealand, and Australia.
- Xs and Os in Zimbabwe and the Republic of Ireland.
- Ultimate tic-tac-toe in some african countries.
- xsie-osies or Exy-ozys in Northern Ireland.
Start playing this glowing Tic Tac Toe game on your iPhone & iPad.
Get Free Tick Tack Toe now and let the fun begin! Be a challenger!
DOWNLOAD and play tic tac toe NOW!

Using their super intellect and newly built spaceships, they returned only to discover all living creatures trapped within mysterious orbs. Rescue the trapped creatures with your trusty claw as you bring life back to these planets. Compete with your friends as you gather collectibles and riches in the wonderful world of Claw Stars - one claw at a time!

• Rescue cute animals and obtain unique collectibles

• Hack, Kidnap and Fool your friends

• Customize your own Spacesuit and Spaceship
• Socialize and participate in fun team events
• Explore an ever-growing universe

The mysteries and treasures of the universe await, so step through the wormhole and enter a new world as you become the ultimate Claw Star!

bluejetty:00089731:ios.description:
Learn Spanish the way your brain was meant to.
Palteca uses teaching methods that are rooted in science, making it one of the most effective ways to quickly learn and speak Spanish. Unlike the majority of the language learning apps on the market today that try to offer a tiny bit of many languages, Palteca offers an in-depth learning experience for Spanish.
---------------------------
THE PALTECA METHOD
1. WATCH REAL NATIVE SPEAKERS: Palteca uses Comprehensible Input (CI), giving you content that is entirely in Spanish spoken by real speakers in real conversations. Our curriculum is built to teach you the most important words first, and over the course of the following days/weeks, continue to reinforce these same words through repeated exposure. This makes remembering much easier
2. SPEAK FROM DAY 1: Get instant feedback so you can begin speaking confidently, while responding to real native Spanish speakers
3. TRAIN YOUR EARS: The sounds in Spanish are different from English and other languages. So we will teach you how to distinguish between similar-sounding words, giving you the ability to better listen to native speakers
4. LEARN HOW TO LEARN A LANGUAGE: Palteca starts by getting you ready to learn how to learn a language. Many people try to learn languages through apps, but grow bored and frustrated when they realize the method isn’t working. Palteca gives you the roadmap to Spanish fluency in and out of the app
---------------------------
PALTECA FEATURES
* Learn only useful vocabulary and phrases
* Practice speaking with real-time feedback 
* Practice listening to real Spanish natives
* Hundreds of activities from speaking, practicing numbers, sounds, and more
* Listen to different accents
---------------------------
PALTECA MEMBERSHIP
A subscription is required to access Palteca. Palteca offers both monthly and annual subscriptions. Once purchased, the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled in your Apple App Store account. When a subscription is canceled, access to Palteca will expire at the end of the current payment period. Refunds will not be given for any unused portion of the term. 
---------------------------
Have questions or need assistance? Contact us at hello@palteca.com.
---------------------------
Terms of Service: https://palteca.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://palteca.com/privacy

SkyView® brings stargazing to everyone. Simply point your iPhone, iPad, or iPod at the sky to identify stars, constellations, planets, satellites, and more!
Over 3.2 million downloads.
App Store Rewind 2011 -- Best Education App
“If you've ever wanted to know what you're looking at in the night sky, this app is the perfect stargazer's companion.” 
– CNET 
"If you’ve ever been looking for a stargazing app for your iPhone, then this [is] definitely the one to get." 
– AppAdvice 
“SkyView is an Augmented Reality app that lets you see just what delights the sky has to offer.” 
– 148Apps Editor’s Choice
You don't need to be an astronomer to find stars or constellations in the sky, just open SkyView® and let it guide you to their location and identify them. SkyView® is a beautiful and intuitive stargazing app that uses your camera to precisely spot and identify celestial objects in sky, day or night. Find all 88 constellations as they fade in and out while you scan across the sky, locate every planet in our solar system, discover distant galaxies, and witness satellite fly-bys.
Features: 
• Simple: Point your device at the sky to identify galaxies, stars, constellations, planets, and satellites (including the ISS and Hubble) passing overhead at your location.
• Sighting Events: schedule alerts for upcoming celestial events.
• Apple Watch: see what objects are visible tonight and how to spot them using your Apple Watch.
• Today Widget: brand new iOS 8 today widget lets you quickly see upcoming celestial events.
• Night Mode: Preserve your night vision with red or green night mode filters.
• Augmented Reality (AR): Use your camera to spot objects in the sky, day or night.
• Sky Paths: Follow the sky track for any object to see it’s exact location in the sky on any date and time.
• Comprehensive: Includes thousands of stars, planets, and satellites with thousands of interesting facts.
• Time Travel: Jump to the future or the past and see the sky on different dates and times.
• Social: Capture and share beautiful images with friends and family on social networks. 
• Mobile: WiFi is NOT required (does not require a data signal or GPS to function). Take it camping, boating, or even flying!
What a fun way to teach yourself, your children, your students, or your friends about our wonderful universe!

bluejetty:00032841:ios.description:
► A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED
Running your own luxury cruise! 
Dive into My Cruise World, a fast-paced time-management game where your goal is to build a lavish accommodation empire and showcase your hospitality skills. 
Manage your cruise ship, make smart investments in staff and property, and work your way to becoming a hospitality tycoon in this addictive and entertaining casual simulator. 
► TOP-NOTCH SERVICE
[Start Your Adventure]
Begin as a modest bellhop, handling tasks like cleaning rooms, welcoming guests, collecting payments, and maintaining supplies. 
As your finances grow, enhance rooms and facilities, and recruit new staff to meet the rising demands on your cruise. 
Your guests may relax, but a cruise tycoon never rests.
[Grow Your Empire]
Unlock and upgrade various rooms, each with unique enhancements to achieve five-star status. 
Show your management skills across different settings, advance to larger properties, and continue your journey to become a cruise tycoon. 
Each room features its own distinct style and atmosphere.
[Keep Moving]
Achieving success requires constant activity. 
Improve movement speed for you and your staff to deliver faster service and keep guests happy, increasing your profits.
[Increase Your Profits]
Equip your cruise with essential amenities. 
From basic bathrooms to luxury vending machines, restaurants, jacuzzis, disco rooms, and swimming pools—every facility increases guest satisfaction and your revenue. 
Ensure you have enough staff to manage each amenity smoothly.
[Create Stylish Spaces]
Upgrade accommodations to improve guest experiences and choose from various room designs in each location. 
In this engaging simulator, you’re not just managing—you’re also designing!
► ENDLESS FUN
Seeking a time-management game that's unique, easy to play, and endlessly entertaining? 
Step into the bustling world of hospitality, develop your skills as a manager, investor, and designer. 
Download My Cruise World now and set sail on an epic journey to build an accommodation empire by the sea!

bluejetty:00090731:ios.description:
Create stunning cover art for your Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, playlists, tracks, albums, and podcasts effortlessly in under a minute with SpotiPlus. 
Crafted by music enthusiasts, SpotiPlus is the ultimate tool to help you organize and enhance the visual appeal of your Spotify experience.
Discover a wide range of design styles tailored to your musical preferences, from Rock to Hip Hop and everything in between. Whether it's Rap caviar, Top pop, or KEXP's Song Of The Day, SpotiPlus has got you covered. Don't wait any longer – try it out today!
___
SpotiPlus will help you attract followers and boost streams by designing professional cover arts for your Spotify playlists.
If you're lacking time or inspiration to make better Spotify playlist covers, we got your back. We offer 100% free templates to start from and customize to match your playlist style.
Key Features:
- No design skills required – an easy-to-use interface for effortless cover art creation.
- Design your own custom images or import existing ones.
- Instantly export your cover art directly to Spotify.
- Download your cover art as a high-quality JPEG for future publishing.
- Choose from a diverse selection of built-in styles to match your unique taste.
- Utilize a powerful editor with customizable fonts, colors, and alignment options.
How To use
1 - Launch the SpotiPlus app.
2 - Select your preferred style.
3 - Make your edits and tap "Done" when finished.
4 - Choose a playlist from your Spotify account and apply the new cover.
5 - Boom! Your playlist cover has been transformed and is now visible to your followers.
Support and Contact
We value your feedback and are eager to hear your thoughts and feature suggestions. Feel free to reach out to us at 7tapsContact@gmail.com to report bugs, share your ideas, or simply say hello.
Terms of Service:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Permissions
SpotiPlus utilizes the Spotify API to access both public and private user playlists, enabling seamless remote cover changes within the app. Please note that SpotiPlus is not affiliated with Spotify.
Get ready to captivate your audience, attract more followers, and amplify your streams with SpotiPlus. Upgrade your Spotify playlist covers now!

bluejetty:00063626:ios.summary:

**Episodes II – VI and other content available via in-app purchases.**
Experience the entire collection
bluejetty:00063626:ios.description:
LEGO® Star Wars™: The Complete Saga is available on iOS for the first time! 
***Episode I Story Mode is FREE for a limited time.***
**Episodes II – VI and other content available via in-app purchases.**
Experience the entire collection that combines the original LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game and the sequel LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy for hours of epic Star Wars content and fun gameplay all from your iOS device! Begin your adventure in Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace and journey through all six episodes in the whimsical style and humor of LEGO. May the bricks be with you!
This game is filled with content! You’ll need 1.44gb of available space on your device if you install over wifi, but only 735mb of space if you download on your computer and then sync. 
As with many large app installations, we advise that you restart your device after installing as this will resolve some stability issues. Also make sure you have installed the most recent firmware.
When re-installing the App, please select ‘Restore All Purchases’ from the main menu and allow a few moments to ensure your purchases have become active.
This is a high memory usage app. If you have performance issues, try closing down background apps or restarting the device.
FEATURES:
36 STORY MODE LEVELS + BONUS CONTENT 
From the Trade Federation’s “negotiations” with Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn in The Phantom Menace to the space battle above Endor in Return of the Jedi, play the most memorable and exhilarating scenes from your favorite episodes. Also unlock special bonus content featuring Bounty Hunter missions, a special Challenge Mode, Arcade Levels, and more! 
OVER 120 CHARACTERS
Play as your favorite Jedi Knight or Sith Lord! There are over 120 playable characters to unlock, including Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, Han Solo, and Boba Fett. 
FORCE POWERS
Which side of the Force will you use? Both dark and light side characters have their own unique Force abilities. Will you use a Force Throw to defeat the Jedi or choose your Lightsaber and Force Push to take down the evil Empire?
LEGO STYLE GAMEPLAY
Smash objects into LEGO bricks and switch characters on the fly as you play through different story levels. Create your own Star Wars character mash-ups like Han Windu and Lando Amidala! 
DYNAMIC CONTROL STYLES
Switch between “Classic” and “Touch Screen” controls to find the play-style that suits you best.
If you enjoy LEGO games, be sure to check out LEGO Batman: DC Super Heroes, LEGO The Lord of the Rings, LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4 and Years 5-7, and LEGO Friends.

bluejetty:00064458:ios.description:
1001 TVs lets you cast your phone or tablet to Windows, Mac, Smart TV, Apple TV—even a web browser. You can also receive screen mirroring from other phones and PCs.
We are a professional team on screen mirroring, always focus on the core features:
[New Feature] TV Remote Control — Auto-detect Smart TVs on the same Wi-Fi and control Power / Volume / Home / Channels / Direction pad (Up/Down/Left/Right) + Select/Confirm.
- Support landscape mode and portrait mode that keep same ratio with phone's screen
- Real-Time screen mirroring, keep best balance with low Latency and good quality
- Audio and video stay perfectly in sync
- Mirror multiple phones to one PC at the same time
- Automatically rotates screen to match your phone’s orientation
- Fit, Fill, or Zoom mode to remove black borders
- Support screen mirroring to older devices that don't support AirPlay or Miracast
- Mirror to any browser (like Chrome) — no app needed on the receiver side
- Live Camera Mirroring — mirror what your camera sees to a big screen in real time. Great for selfies, support mirror flip
- Whiteboard — draw or write and share in real time on TV or PC
Also provide additional features:
* Photo Albums — Upload and display photos on your TV
* Web Streaming — Stream videos, music, and images to Smart TVs
* Fast File Transfer — Quickly send files between devices without cables
How to Get Started?
# Install 1001 TVs on your phone and the device you want to cast to (PC, TV or tablet)
# Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network
# Open the app, select a device, and start mirroring
No cables, no complicated setup — just tap and go.
[Feedback]
Reach out to us at 1001tvs@nero.com or visit our website: www.1001tvs.com
[Subscription Plan]
-Service Title: Auto-renew Weekly, Auto-renew Monthly, Auto-renew Yearly and Lifetime;
-Your payment will be charged to your store account once you confirm the purchase;
-Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period;
-You can always cancel the subscription through your store account;
[Terms of Use]
http://1001tvs.com/license/en/terms.html
[Privacy Policy]
http://1001tvs.com/license/en/privacy.html
For privacy, screen casting data remains within your local network and will never be uploaded.

Launch a wheel, steer down hills, dodge obstacles, and reach the finish!
In Go Wheel!, the player launches a wheel from a powerful slingshot and guides it down a thrilling, obstacle-filled hill to reach the finish line. *Find your voice with Astound*
Speaking with confidence doesn't come naturally to most of us. Whether it's leading a meeting, pitching an idea, teaching a class, or recording a podcast — your voice carries more weight than you think.
And yet, very few of us ever receive real training on how to use it. That's why we built Astound.
Most users notice a real shift within just a few days of practice: greater calm, more confidence, stronger presence. With daily recordings, you can hear your own progress as it happens.
We know speaking can feel nerve-racking — even when it's not a big stage. That shaky feeling before you present? You're not alone. Astound helps you turn those nerves into calm energy and presence.
*Our approach is different*
Instead of obsessing over filler words, we focus on how your voice makes you — and your listeners — feel. You'll learn to breathe with intention, speak with authenticity, and adapt your voice to fit any room.
With 100+ bite-sized exercises, guided breathing techniques, voice recordings, affirmations, and progress tracking, daily practice becomes simple, approachable, and even something to look forward to.
Your voice is your power. Astound teaches you how to use it.
-----------------------

- 100+ easy-to-follow video tutorials
- A 30-Day Challenge that gradually builds your voice toward your chosen goal
- Practice packs for specific moments — job interviews, presentations, podcasts, and more

- Favorite exercises for quick access
- Daily reminders to build a lasting habit

bluejetty:00073763:ios.description:
Shop smarter with Consumer Reports by your side. Discover products worth buying, compare your options, find deals, and get trusted answers backed by CR's independent testing, research, and expertise.
Whether you're looking for your next car, replacing an appliance, searching for the best products for your home, or just curious about what's worth buying, the Consumer Reports app makes it easier to shop confidently.
Discover what's worth buying
Explore Product Collections
Discover trending products and expert-curated collections designed to help you find your next great buy.
Watch the latest from CR
Get useful shopping advice and consumer insights right in your feed, with videos covering products, CR testing, important consumer issues, and more.
Find deals and ways to save
Discover deals and discounts on products worth considering, plus tools like Best Time to Buy that can help you decide when it's worth making a purchase.
Research, compare, and shop
AskCR
Ask questions and get answers backed by Consumer Reports' trusted expertise. Use AskCR to research products and cars, compare your options, narrow down your choices, and find the right product for your needs.
Ratings & Reviews
Access CR ratings and reviews for thousands of products, cars, and services based on independent testing, research, and consumer surveys.
Image Scan
Shopping in a store? Scan a barcode or take a photo of a product to quickly find CR ratings and information, compare your options, and make a more informed decision on the spot.
Product Comparisons
Compare products and cars side by side to see how your options stack up, and find the best choice for you.
Buying Guides
Get expert guidance on what to consider before you buy, from major appliances and electronics to cars and everyday products.
Save Your Favorites
Save products and comparisons so you can easily come back to them when you're ready to make a decision.
Get even more from Membership
Consumer Reports members get full access to features including:
• Unlimited AskCR conversations
• Ratings and reviews for thousands of products and services
• CR Recommended products
• Image Scan
• Exclusive member deals and discounts
• Best Time to Buy
• Additional member benefits and exclusive partnerships
• Extra savings with Bill Negotiator
Not a member yet? Consumer Reports is free to download, with access to select features including Buying Guides, Bill Negotiator, Product Collections, videos, and limited access to AskCR. You can join Consumer Reports directly through the app to unlock the full experience.
Consumer Reports is an independent, nonprofit organization that works side by side with consumers to create a fairer, safer, and healthier world. CR buys the products it tests and does not accept advertising, helping you make informed decisions with independent insights you can trust.
From discovering your next purchase to making the final decision, keep Consumer Reports with you and shop with confidence.

bluejetty:00022091:ios.description:
■ MazM Membership ■
If you are subscribed to MazM Membership, please log in with the same ID.
You can use all of this game's content for free.
In this narrative adventure, you follow a young traveler across borderlands, facing loss, hope, and hard choices. Set against a turbulent era, the journey unfolds like a book you can play—quiet, emotional, and deeply human.
■ Story & Genre
This is a full-length visual novel and story game that centers on people rather than battles. If you enjoy story games and storyline game experiences, you'll feel right at home. The plot moves through layered conversations, letters, and memories, capturing the weight of history and the warmth found in small kindnesses. For fans of sad games and emotional game narratives, its tone balances melancholy with resilience.
■ Gameplay Features
Play at your pace. Read, make dialogue choices, and uncover side episodes to learn more about each character. Interactive stories meet adventure games sensibilities: no grinding, no timers—just choices that shape how you understand the people you meet. Whether you prefer story mode games or interactive story games, the focus stays on immersion.
■ Key Highlights
• A crafted, chaptered story with clear arcs—from arrival, to parting, to quiet reckonings.
• Choice-driven reading: multiple routes and unlockable side stories for deeper context.
• Timeless presentation: clean UI, evocative soundtrack, and illustrations that feel like a diary come to life.
• Designed for players who seek the best story games, not twitch reflexes.
• Works great for short sessions or long weekends—your progress autosaves.
■ About MazM
• MazM is a story and adventure game studio that reimagines classic novels and various works as games.
• Like the lingering emotions you feel after a memorable book, movie, or musical, we aim to deliver deep immersion and lasting impact to our players.
• Experience unique adventures through the visual novel and story game titles created by MazM.
• We will continue to craft story games that deliver unforgettable narratives and emotions.
[MazM Membership]
MazM membership begins upon payment, and charges are applied on a monthly basis. 
There is no long-term contract or cancellation fee, and you can easily cancel online at any time, 24 hours a day.
The information collected through MazM games for iOS and iPadOS is subject to the Growing Seeds Corporation's privacy policy.
If you would like to learn more about the information collected by Growing Seeds Corporation in other situations, such as during account registration, please refer to Growing Seeds Corporation's privacy policy (see the link below).
Privacy Policy: https://www.storymazm.com/privacy-policy-en
Terms of Service: https://www.storymazm.com/terms-of-service-en

bluejetty:00014198:ios.description:
Start banking wherever you are with FMBSC_ToGo Mobile for iPad and iPhone! Available to all Farmers and Merchants Bank of South Carolina online banking customers, FMBSC_ToGo Mobile allows you to check balances, make transfers, pay bills, pay a person, make deposits, access via Touch ID or Passcode and find locations. Need to find a Branch or ATM closest to you? With Find Near Me, FMBSC_ToGo Mobile will discover your location and provide you with addresses and phone numbers on the fly.
Available features include:
Accounts
- Check your latest account balance and search recent transactions by date, amount, or check number.
Transfers
- Easily transfer cash between your accounts.
Pay Bills
-Easily pay bills anytime on the fly.
-Add, edit and delete Payees
People Pay
- Send and receive payments to individuals by email only or via email and phone (text).
Deposit Checks
-Easily make a check deposit.
Passcode
- Allows user to enter a numeric passcode (instead of user name, password, challenge).
Touch ID
- Allows user to set up access to mobile banking using fingerprint after authenticating with full credentials.
Locations
- Find nearby Branches and ATMs using the iPhone's built-in GPS. Additionally, you can search by zip code or address.
All features may not be available in the tablet application.

▷ 4 Minute High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)

▷ 10 Seconds of Rest
▷ 8 Intervals

bluejetty:00091027:ios.summary:
Discover Joy Cafe: The Ultimate Merging Game for Coffee and Food Lovers!
Indulge in the perfect blend of entertainment with our delightful merging game – Joy Cafe! If you're a true aficionado of coffee, fine food, and the excitement of mer
bluejetty:00091027:ios.description:
Discover Joy Cafe: The Ultimate Merging Game for Coffee and Food Lovers!
Indulge in the perfect blend of entertainment with our delightful merging game – Joy Cafe! If you're a true aficionado of coffee, fine food, and the excitement of merge games, then this exceptional coffee shop simulation game has been meticulously crafted just for you.
Merge and Manage Your Dream Café!
Step boldly into the shoes of a visionary culinary entrepreneur and craft your very own coffee shop empire! Merge diverse ingredients, conjure up delectable desserts, and serve up the most scrumptious coffee creations to your ever-expanding clientele. Elevate your menu, sharpen your culinary skills, and witness the astonishing transformation of your café into an unrivaled culinary masterpiece.
Master the Art of Coffee and Cooking
Unleash your inner culinary maestro as you seamlessly merge ingredients, fashioning mouthwatering treats that push the boundaries of taste. Ascend to the status of a master barista, expertly brewing the perfect cup of coffee to satiate the palates of fervent caffeine enthusiasts. This isn't merely a casual kitchen game; it is an immersive simulation of the culinary universe. Assume the mantle of a skillful kitchen manager, optimizing resources, steering your team, and asserting your dominance in the realm of restaurant games!
Design Your Café Wonderland
Unleash your innate flair for interior design and metamorphose your café into a chic haven of aesthetic wonder. Effortlessly merge elements to unlock a captivating array of décor styles, allowing you to meticulously tailor your coffee shop's ambiance – from the rustic allure of a quaint bakery to the contemporary elegance of a sophisticated patisserie. Whether you're cultivating an intimate corner for coffee talk or curating an inviting dessert display, the power rests in your hands to craft an atmosphere that beckons customers back for more.
Where Coffee and Desserts Meet Romance
Prepare to be captivated by a symphony of drama, romance, and tantalizing flavors! Engage with your customers to unearth their cherished preferences, delighting them with an array of delectable desserts and specialty coffee concoctions that are certain to leave them yearning for more. From the inquisitive librarian to the discerning coffee connoisseur, every palate will be gratified by the exquisite flavors you serve.
Aim for the Apex of the Coffee Scene
While merging ingredients is undeniably gratifying, the fusion of minds holds even greater allure! Strive for culinary supremacy in an array of cooking challenges and events. Unveil your barista expertise to the world and endeavor to seize the coveted top spot. Forge connections with fellow players, inviting friends to partake in this shared culinary journey. Remember, the joys multiply when they're shared!
Craft Your Unique Café Narrative
Empower yourself to sculpt your culinary destiny within the enchanting realm of Joy Cafe! Embrace the art of merging, effective management, and inventive creation to foster a café that is a true reflection of your individuality. Regardless of whether you're an aspiring barista or an aspiring coffee shop magnate, this merging game is the ultimate fusion of coffee, cooking, and carefree amusement.
Embark on Your Joyful Journey Now!
Download Joy Cafe and immerse yourself in the creation of your own café saga. Brew a storm, merge your way to success, and unravel the delightful narrative of your very own cafe story!

bluejetty:00038648:ios.description:
Play free Belote and Coinche online card game with random opponents, Friends or Family members. 
Belote Coinche Multiplayer is a cards game with the most comfortable user interface and absolutely random dealing of cards! 
Belotе is a well known card game in many countries and has various names such as Klaberjass, Klaverjassen, Baloot, Vida, βίδα, Pilotta, Bela, blot, Блот, Базар Блот, bazar blot, Бридж Белот and so on.
Play free Belote Coinche Multiplayer more to get new Levels, join to the Leagues, earn generous Bonuses! Communicate with players, send them Gifts and have a fun. 
Whether you are on the go or enjoy your leisure time playing games in your phone or tablet, then download Belote Coinche Multiplayer by Start playing belote card game with your live rivals, your Friends or Family members. 
Play belote online in 3 different game types: 
- Belote – classic rules with an initial dealing of 5 cards; 
- Coinche – without declaration of card combinations and NO “All Trump” or “No Trump” game modes;
- Coinche NT/AT – with declaration of card combinations and with the “No Trump” and “All Trump” game modes (similar to armenian bazar blot with some difference). 
Belote Coinche Multiplayer is an interesting free belote game, which can be played Offline as well to Practice skills. 
The following Modes are available:
- Play with a computer and improve your skills without spending your chips;
- Play belote online with random players in different rooms with varied entries; 
- Play in Private rooms with Friends or Family members by sharing with them the room code.
Just start your first free belote (blot) or coinche (bazar blot) match with opponents from all over the world with 6 different entrance fees with different rewards – prizes starting from 100 up to 6 000 coins. Whether you are a beginner or experienced player, fun is guaranteed when playing this challenging blot card game! 
Download it now and try it out!
Find out more: https://www.facebook.com/N1BeloteCoinche/?ref=bookmarks

ElonAI: Chat & Answer Engine is the ultimate AI assistant that makes your everyday conversations smarter, faster, and more enjoyable. Designed for students, professionals, creators, and curious minds, ElonAI helps you find answers, create content, translate languages, organize ideas, and stay productive—all from one powerful app.
With cutting-edge artificial intelligence, ElonAI adapts to your needs in real time. Whether you want to research a topic, improve your writing, learn something new, or spark creative ideas, ElonAI delivers instant, accurate, and engaging results.
What You Can Do with ElonAI
Ask Anything, Anytime: Get quick answers to questions on any subject, from science and history to pop culture and daily life.
Perfect Your Writing: Automatically correct grammar, refine tone, and make your sentences clear and professional.
Simplify Complex Text: Summarize articles, documents, and reports into easy-to-understand language—even for a 2nd grader.
Translate Seamlessly: Convert English text into French, Spanish, or Japanese with natural, fluent translations.
Ace Your Interviews: Generate tailored interview questions for any role or industry.
Plan & Organize: Create structured outlines for essays, projects, and reports.
Generate Creative Ideas: Build product names, taglines, or marketing slogans with AI inspiration.
Study Smarter: Receive detailed, well-organized notes on any subject to speed up learning.
And More: Explore a growing library of AI tools for productivity, learning, and creativity.
Why Choose ElonAI?
All-in-One Solution: No need for multiple apps—everything you need for communication, creativity, and learning is in one place.
Time-Saving: Cut hours of research, editing, and brainstorming into minutes.
Accessible to Everyone: From beginners to power users, ElonAI’s interface is simple and intuitive.
Always Improving: We constantly update features to bring you the latest in AI technology.
Whether you’re writing an email, preparing for a meeting, learning a new language, or planning your next big idea, ElonAI is your trusted partner in getting it done better and faster.
Important Notice: Do not share personal or sensitive information in chats. AI-generated content may occasionally be inaccurate, offensive, or harmful. ElonAI is not responsible for generated content.

bluejetty:00074624:ios.description:
LUXURY FASHION AND LIFESTYLE DESTINATION
The official SSENSE app offers a seamless shopping experience geared to your needs. Discover new season arrivals, trending designers, exclusive collaborations, and limited-release collections across womenswear, menswear, kidswear, and Everything Else™. Shop a curated edit of over 500 luxury and lifestyle brands, emerging designers, and streetwear labels, including Gucci, Essentials, Aesop, Jacquemus, Moncler, Alexander McQueen, Converse, Balenciaga, Off-White, Saint Laurent, Versace, and hundreds more. Featuring easy navigation, quick searches, simple filters, sales alerts, and daily style drops. The SSENSE app is accessible in English, French, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese. Delivery to over 150 countries worldwide.
INTUITIVE SHOPPING
Use our filter options to shop by brand or category and explore over 60,000 styles from more than 500 luxury brands and independent designer labels.
PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS
Browse personalized product selections based on your preferences and recent shopping activity.
UP-TO-DATE ALERTS
Enable push notifications and be the first to know about the latest product drops, new collections, SSENSE collaborations and partnerships, as well as sales and promotional offers.
ORDER TRACKING
Keep track of your shopping history and current orders and get the latest updates on your shipments, all in one place.
STREAMLINED CHECKOUT
Enjoy a seamless shopping experience from product discovery to hassle-free checkout, and expedited delivery.
YOUR WISHLIST
Save your favorite designer styles and lifestyle pieces in your wishlist and add them to your shopping cart when you are ready to purchase.
SOCIAL SHARING
Share your coveted designer styles, notable SSENSE collaborations, and limited-release product drops on your preferred social media network including Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and iMessages.
SSENSE (pronounced [es-uhns]) is a global technology platform and fashion and lifestyle shopping destination blurring the lines between culture and commerce. It is renowned for its distinctive offering of established and emerging luxury brands, streetwear labels, and original editorial features and cultural content. Visit www.ssense.com and follow @ssense for new arrivals, exclusive collaborations, special offers, and much more. The customer care team is available in 5 languages, 24/7 at customercare@ssense.com.

bluejetty:00069940:ios.description:
Winner’s Soccer 2014 is a real 3D competitive football game. It includes the teams and the latest football players’ data of 2014 World Cup. There are various modes for you to select, such as Cup, League Match and Friendly Match. It has up to 126 teams and 2600 players. Smooth actions and playback function let you feel like you actually in the game. 
1．Game Modes
 This game has various modes, including Cup (World Cup, Club Cup), League Match (Premier League, Lega Serie A, La Liga and CSL), Friendly Match and Penalty Shootout. It also has a training mode for you to train skills of your team, dividing into Primary, Medium and Advanced.
Friendly Match Mode: You can select 2 teams from 62 club teams to compete or shoot penalty.
Cup Mode: You can select your favorite team from 64 national teams to participate the World Cup. 
League Mode, You can select one team from Britain, Italy, Spain or China to compete for championship.
Training Mode: You can select a team to perfect its operation skills.
2. Various Operation Skills
 This game provides two kinds of operation modes. You can choose the most suitable one. (You can change mode in Options under Menu or tap button || to activate Menu in game.)
You can read Control Method in Help of Options under Menu.
The operation adopts an international popular way, setting 5 pass ball keys: Short Pass /Press and Long Pass/Slide Tackle, Shoot, Through Pass/GK Rush Out, Long through Pass and Special Dribble /Focus Change.
Short Pass: It is short pass in offense. Let controller press opponent dribbler in defense.
Long Pass: Press Power Accumulate and pass the ball to a mate of appropriate distance after release. Let controller slide tackle when defend.
Shoot: Make different shooting actions according to Power Accumulate and the distance between player and ball.
Special Dribble: Including many special dribble actions: Marsille roulette, Step over, Step over and Pull back.
Automatic combination skills:
Through Pass: Pass ball to catcher according to Power Accumulate.
Long through Pass: Pass ball to catcher with Long Pass according to Power Accumulate.
Sprint: Rapid dribble, fasten speed of dribble but worsen control of ball.
Drive ball out: Stop ball far away from body and facilitate dribble starting acceleration.
Dribble with far distance: Double click in front when fast dribble can dribble farther and facilitate fast run.
Fake Shoot and Fake Long pass: Pressing Short Pass when (or after) Shoot or Power Accumulate will cancel shoot or long pass. They are used to dribble past opponent Defenders or GK.
One-Two pass: Two players cooperate to dribble past opponent Defenders.
Lob shoot: Press Special Dribble to shoot.
Control tracks of ball: Press direction keys to control the flying arc of ball.

apple-macos:6761746766.description:
Distance should never decide whether a moment can be shared.
Make distance feel like the same second.
WeSync is a real-time synchronized viewing and messaging app for friends, couples, and families. Create a room, invite someone, and watch web, cloud, or local videos together. Play, pause, seeking, and playback progress stay synchronized, allowing people far apart to share the same moment.
REAL-TIME PLAYBACK SYNC
The room synchronizes play, pause, seeking, and playback progress. After a network fluctuation, WeSync continues calibrating playback to bring everyone back to the same moment.
GLOBAL DANMAKU
Friends' messages travel across the picture as Danmaku while the video plays. Keep watching without switching screens, and share every comment, reply, and reaction at exactly the right moment.
WATCH YOUR WAY, TOGETHER
Open a web video in the built-in browser, choose content from a supported cloud drive, or play a local video on your device. You bring the video. WeSync brings everyone into the same room.
WATCH AND TALK
Room messages stay over the picture, so you never need to leave the moment. Live voice lets conversations, laughter, and even silence happen naturally.
FRIENDS AND MESSAGES
Add friends, start conversations, view message history, and quickly invite the people who matter into a watch room.
Start in three steps:
1. Create a watch room
2. Invite a friend
3. Choose a video and press play
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Voice calls and cloud watch parties require WeSync Pro for the host.
Contact:
contact@proxivisual.com

flathub:org.processing.processingide.name: Processing IDE
flathub:org.processing.processingide.description:
Processing is the first easy-to-use software sketching platform created by C. Reas and B. Fry
 and supported by the Processing Foundation.
 Included is an integrated development environment that can be used to develop interactive applications
 using different programming languages but mainly Java, Android, Python, and Javascript.
 Known issues:
 Python sketches can run but you may have trouble stopping them running. If so, you will have
 to use your system monitor application of choice (such as htop) to close the sketch, as it will
 be the only way to stop the sketch, other than closing the IDE itself. This problem also persists
 outside of Flatpak. See: https://github.com/flathub/org.processing.processingide/issues/5
 When trying to open a Python sketch other than an example sketch in the "Examples" dialog,
 the IDE may crash and close by itself. This problem also persists outside of Flatpak. See: https://github.com/benfry/processing4/issues/793
 Python Mode for Processing is currently unmaintained and a new maintainer is currently being
 sought after. It can still be downloaded and run via the Contribution Manager by going to the
 mode selection dialog and clicking "Mode Manager -> Modes -> Python Mode for Processing
 4 -> Install". See: https://github.com/jdf/processing.py/blob/1932b4ca71f3befd333cc23d3a1c8fe7617014ff/README.markdown#this-project-is-not-maintained

apple-macos:1643137606.name: MyMusicComping
apple-macos:1643137606.description:
Designed primarily for conservatory professors, MyMusicComping is fully adaptable for use by professional pianists, teachers in music schools, and academies.
MyMusicComping stems from its programmer's experience as an accompanist and aims to meet all the needs that professionals may encounter in their work:
- Organize your students by specialty, level, or tutor.
- View your students' information, the repertoire you work on with each of them, and a personalized record of their rehearsals with you.
- Organize your entire repertoire by composer and instrument, indicate its difficulty, and link it to the rehearsals where it is performed and the students who work on it.
- Keep track of all rehearsals by date, indicating whether it was performed in public or recorded.
- Add evaluations and ratings, if needed. - Keep track of all your auditions and concerts, organized by specialty and date, with a list of participating students and the repertoire each one performed.
- Access your scores in PDF format directly from the app, or linked to major online repositories.
- Integrate the app with the ForScore application if you use it on your iPad.
- Receive and schedule notifications and timers for your rehearsals.
- Integrate app data with your system calendar.
- Connect app data with Calendly's online booking system.
- Keep your data organized and up-to-date with simple, flexible, and effective update and maintenance processes.
- Import data from external sources and export it for future reference and archiving in CSV format.
- Share your rehearsals with the tutors of the students you play with who use MyMusicClass app.
MyMusicComping data—which you can protect with a password and your devices' biometric security—is securely stored encrypted in your iCloud account and automatically synced across all your devices, allowing you to work seamlessly across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
MyMusicComping is available in English and Spanish in App Stores worldwide.

apple-macos:6811428611.name: Project Hub: Work & Travel
apple-macos:6811428611.description:
Project Hub keeps everything a project needs in one calm place: your trips, your daily work log, your expenses and receipts, your deadlines and appointments. With one tap it turns them into finished documents – a travel expense report, a work log or a complete project dossier as a PDF.
NEW: MEETINGS INTO TRANSCRIPTS
One tap on the recorder widget records a meeting. Project Hub turns it into a transcript on your device and writes a title, a summary and the to-dos – on every iPhone. One more tap logs the conversation as work time.
YOUR OWN TEMPLATES
Design a template once and it applies automatically to every document you choose. Your name, company, address, phone and email fill in by themselves. Write letters laid out for window envelopes and export your hours for any period as a PDF or CSV.
DEADLINES & APPOINTMENTS WIDGET
All upcoming deadlines and appointments on your Home Screen, including Apple Calendar. Switch between all, deadlines and appointments, page through the list and tick off deadlines with a tap: open, in progress, done. Overdue deadlines stay visible until they are done.
PROJECTS AS FOLDERS
Every project is a beautifully designed folder. Open it to see the next trip, this week's hours, the costs so far and the next appointment at a glance.
TRIPS WITH REAL ROUTES
Log trips by car, train or plane. Project Hub calculates driving distances with Apple Maps, shows the route on a map and keeps departure and return times for meal allowances.
TRAVEL EXPENSE REPORTS IN ONE TAP
Choose your trips and create a PDF with mileage, meal allowances, deductions for provided meals and all linked receipts.
WORK LOG, DAY BY DAY
Record what you worked on and for how long. Use the timer, the Home Screen widget, the Live Activity or simply ask Siri. Weeks and days add up on their own.
EXPENSES AND RECEIPTS
Scan a receipt with the camera – the text is recognized on your device. Link expenses to trips so they land in the expense report automatically.
CALENDAR
Meetings, deadlines and trips in one calendar, optionally synced with Apple Calendar. One tap turns a meeting into logged work time.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account and no server. Your data is encrypted with AES-256 and stored on your device or in an iCloud Drive folder you choose, unlocked with Face ID or your passcode. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
Available in English, German and Arabic.
